title: Senior Wordpress Developer (Subscription & Circulation Systems)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate WordPress with subscription, paywall, and circulation systems .
  • Build and maintain API integrations between WordPress and external platforms.
  • Ensure reliable synchronization of user data, subscriptions, billing, and content access .
  • Design backend services and middleware to support multi-system communication .
  • Work closely with product and data teams to support subscription and audience workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data flows across systems for performance and reliability.
  • Develop scalable solutions for high-traffic media platforms .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with backend focus.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and distributed systems .
  • Experience with platforms such as Darwin CX and Naviga NCS Circ .
  • Experience with subscription/paywall systems and audience management platforms.
  • Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST/webhooks.
  • Experience integrating WordPress with external SaaS platforms or enterprise systems .
  • Understanding of authentication, data synchronization, and system reliability.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
About the Company

Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting ecommerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization. We're a specialist e-commerce and creative strategy firm that uses AI-augmented engineering and our CDN engineering heritage to deliver high-performance, scalable digital retail experiences that deliver exceptional revenue performance and growth. Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.



About the Role

We design and ship headless commerce frontends for major retail brands — high-traffic storefronts where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly impacts conversion rates and revenue. You'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams: designing front-end architectures, breaking epics into implementable stories, establishing the coding standards that keep a multi-team codebase coherent, and resolving ambiguity before it reaches a sprint. You'll work directly with clients during discovery and sprint planning, partner with leads and senior engineers through design reviews and ADRs, and collaborate async-first across time zones. The path leads to Principal Architecture with client-facing strategic influence across our commerce practice.


Responsibilities

  • Design and own front-end architectures using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for enterprise commerce implementations
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity
  • Lead architectural decisions on rendering strategies, state management, caching, and performance optimization — and document them in ADRs
  • Drive Core Web Vitals performance across your delivery team, establishing standards engineers build against in every PR
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably
  • Collaborate with clients during discovery to translate business needs into scalable, pragmatic architecture roadmaps
  • Resolve technical ambiguity before sprint — unblocking engineers and escalating architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation

Qualifications

  • Proven architectural experience designing front-end systems and leading distributed engineering teams (3+ people)
  • Deep proficiency in Next.js (App Router, React Server Components), React, TypeScript, and modern web architecture — SSR strategies, edge computing, serverless patterns
  • Performance engineering expertise: Core Web Vitals optimization, CDN configuration, caching strategies, and a track record of shipping measurable improvements
  • Strong written and verbal English — you'll align technical work with client expectations, explain architectural tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, and define the conventions engineers build against
  • Evidence of designing work for agentic operation — not just personal AI tool usage, but structuring how teams work with agents: writing specs agents can execute, maintaining documentation as context infrastructure, and decomposing features so that agent-generated output is reviewable and reliable


Required Skills

  • Familiarity with commerce platforms (Shopify Storefront API, SFCC Composable Storefront, Big Commerce)
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Contentstack)


Preferred Skills

  • Tools: React, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Shopify Plus / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Big Commerce / SCAYLE
  • Vercel, CI/CD pipelines
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code, ChatGPT
  • Jest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence


What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company.
  • AI: Premium AI tooling licenses (Cursor and/or Claude Code) for your entire team, with organizational support for building AI-first delivery practices.



Equal Opportunity Statement

Space Dinosaurs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
Business Development Representative Mid


About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the Opportunity:


Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.


You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.



Responsibilities:


Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.

Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.

Make cold calls when necessary.

Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.

Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).

Partner closely with Account Executives.



Requirements


Fluent English (spoken and written).

Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.

Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.

Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.



Nice to Have:


Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).

Background in consulting or IT services companies.

Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.




Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).
  • Knowledge of monitoring/logging tools (App Insights, CloudWatch, DataDog).
  • Experience with performance profiling



This is a CLT Role at R$18,000/month

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Sobre a empresa:

  • Empresa multinacional do setor Financeiro até Logística para marcas de consumo nos EUA e na UE.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Supervisionar a alocação de estoque para pedidos B2B de múltiplas marcas que operam nos EUA e na Europa
  • Projetar a disponibilidade de estoque e fornecer visibilidade dos prazos futuros de entrega com base nos recebimentos de estoque
  • Recomendar ajustes ou extensões nos prazos das janelas de entrega para pedidos ou grupos de produtos, conforme a disponibilidade de estoque
  • Coordenar com o financeiro para garantir que os pedidos sejam liberados para cobrança antes dos embarques
  • Liberar pedidos para os armazéns com base nas janelas de entrega e garantir que as priorizações estejam alinhadas às necessidades do negócio
  • Colaborar com o especialista de logística outbound para acompanhar as prioridades diárias e o progresso junto aos 3PLs
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para as equipes de vendas dos clientes, fornecendo atualizações de status, ajustes e feedback sobre os pedidos


O que você precisa ter:

  • Fluente em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito
  • Pessoa proativa, orientada a soluções e focada em escalabilidade
  • Experiência em alocação de pedidos, customer success ou gestão da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Tem vontade de aprender a dinâmica de gerenciar múltiplos clientes e varejistas em diferentes países
  • Possui fortes habilidades organizacionais, de comunicação e de resolução de problemas, com grande atenção aos detalhes
  • Tem familiaridade com operações de 3PL, sistemas de gestão de pedidos ou ferramentas de planejamento de inventário (diferencial)
  • Sabe gerenciar prioridades e se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança


Observações:

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ

title: Analista de Produto Júnior (Vibecoder)
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Procuramos um estudante ou recém-formado em Economia (ou áreas correlatas) que queira acelerar sua entrada no mercado de tecnologia através da Inteligência Artificial Operacional.

Você não será um programador focado em sintaxe tradicional, mas um Vibecoder: um profissional que utiliza o poder do Claude Code e agentes de IA para construir, gerenciar e escalar serviços de dados reais na nuvem.

O que você vai fazer (The Vibe)

● Vibe Coding: Operar o Claude Code para conectar repositórios no GitHub, baixar skills e automatizar processos de dados com velocidade de IA.

● Gestão de Cloud: Supervisionar e configurar a infraestrutura no Google Cloud (Functions, Run, BigQuery) com o apoio das nossas ferramentas.

● Curadoria de UX: Sabemos que você não é designer e não esperamos que saiba usar ferramentas de desenho. Nós vamos te treinar para desenvolver um senso crítico apurado sobre hierarquia de informação. Seu papel será supervisionar e guiar as IAs para que o produto final seja útil, claro e eficiente para o usuário.

Perfil do Candidato

● Background Analítico (Economia/Exatas): Capacidade de entender a lógica de custos, incentivos e eficiência de processos.

● Mindset Pragmático: Foco em resolver o problema do cliente da forma mais inteligente e automatizada possível.

● Curiosidade Tecnológica: Vontade de dominar o ecossistema Google Cloud e ferramentas de \"coding-by-chat\".

● Vontade de Aprender: Disposição para passar pelo nosso treinamento proprietário de UX e Cloud.

O que oferecemos

● Treinamento de Elite: Acesso ao nosso Gem de IA, um tutor exclusivo que te guiará passo a passo em Cloud, Vibe Coding e Design Crítico.

● Cultura AI-First: Ambiente onde a produtividade via IA é a regra, não a exceção.

● Autonomia Real: Espaço para gerenciar produtos de dados e influenciar decisões de arquitetura e interface.



Benefícios:

Assistência Médica e odontológica · Seguro de Vida · Vale Alimentação/Refeição · Gympass ️ · 3 Days Off por ano

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer (Motion) with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion.


You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentation and motion graphics.


This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation and smart use of AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.



What you’ll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements - including transitions, text animations, graphics packages and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.



What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.



Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility - powered by smart tech, streamlined systems and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative and be part of a modern creative operation - we’d love to hear from you.



Benefits

  • USD-based compensation
  • Work from anywhere

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Alô Linkedin! Estamos com vagas disponíveis para você na TAAK!


Estamos recrutando um Desenvolvedor Salesforce para integrar nossa equipe na TAAK. Se você tem paixão por programação e deseja trabalhar com uma das plataformas de CRM mais avançadas do mercado, essa vaga é ideal para você!


Desenvolvedor Salesforce (Remoto)


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicações na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Implementar soluções técnicas de alta qualidade para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Colaborar com consultores e arquitetos para desenhar soluções eficientes.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as novas funcionalidades e atualizações da plataforma Salesforce.



Requisitos:

  • Formação em áreas relacionadas à tecnologia, como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou afins.
  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação orientada a objetos (Java, C#, etc.).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce, incluindo Apex, Visualforce e Lightning Components.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Apex na plataforma Salesforce (automação, controladores, processos assíncronos)
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de interfaces visuais no Salesforce, utilizando VisualForce Pages, Aura Components, Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Experiência com integração de APIs, desenvolvimento de serviços web e API’s padrão Salesforce
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de testes unitários
  • Certificações Salesforce.



Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Cordova, React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, etc.).
  • Experiência com Lightning Web Components (LWC) para desenvolvimento moderno em Salesforce.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento mobile utilizando frameworks como Node.js, Cordova, React Native, Flutter, ou Kotlin.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs e serviços web no Salesforce.
  • Familiaridade com DevOps e automação de processos no ambiente Salesforce.
  • Experiência com o desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile utilizando a Salesforce Mobile SDK.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento Salesforce.
  • Participação em projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais relacionados à tecnologia.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.

  • Step 2: Tiragem

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:


  • Atender às ocorrências operacionais relacionadas a ambientes da empresa, como vazamentos, falhas elétricas, problemas em vestiários, refeitório, banheiros, entre outros.
  • Acionar fornecedores de manutenção corretiva e acompanhar a execução dos serviços contratados.
  • Verificar no local a natureza do problema e registrar a ocorrência de forma adequada.
  • Conferir se os serviços foram realizados conforme combinado, observando prazos, qualidade e emissão da nota fiscal.
  • Utilizar o sistema de gestão de viagens corporativas para registrar, acompanhar e controlar solicitações, aprovações, reservas e prestação de contas.
  • Apoiar o controle das rotinas operacionais de Facilities, em interface com a equipe.
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento do transporte fretado, consumo no restaurante e funcionamento dos equipamentos e estruturas da unidade.
  • Manter registros atualizados em planilhas e relatórios simples de ocorrências e atendimentos realizados.
  • Apoiar o controle orçamentário da área, acompanhando os gastos mensais com serviços de Facilities e viagens, e comparando com o previsto.
  • Sinalizar ao Supervisor e a equipe, eventuais falhas ou desvios operacionais.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo, desejável cursando Ensino Superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA.
  • Desejável conhecimento na execução de atividades operacionais relacionadas aos serviços de Facilities como: viagens, hospedagens, combustíveis, táxi, locações de veículos (Frota), apoio quanto a solicitação dos materiais de limpeza e fardamentos, cadastros de fornecedores internos;
  • Vivência com o sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Product Manager – Clientes Estratégicos
description:
Venha integrar um time de excelência, somos a Eyemobile uma startup que nasceu para revolucionar o varejo! ✨


Nossa missão é simplificar a forma como negócios vendem através de inovação e tecnologia.


Estamos há 12 anos no mercado, e em nossa história, temos muitos aprendizados e conquistas, que nos ajudaram a construir uma cultura sólida, com base em três pilares: o Cuidar, Imaginar e Simplificar. Tudo isso pensando em nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e na tecnologia.


Se você se identifica com valores como: Simplicidade, Agilidade, Confiança, Inovação e Experiência do Cliente , já está há um passo à frente! Então, continue lendo para conhecer mais sobre essa oportunidade que pode mudar sua carreira!


➡️ Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Manager para atuar na frente de Clientes Estratégicos , liderando a entrega e evolução de soluções em contextos de alta complexidade, múltiplas integrações e forte impacto comercial.


Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar um portfólio de clientes relevantes, atuando de forma end-to-end — desde o entendimento do problema até a entrega em produção — com responsabilidade direta sobre o sucesso das iniciativas.


Aqui, não buscamos um perfil focado apenas em backlog ou execução. Procuramos alguém com ownership, capaz de equilibrar demandas de clientes, viabilidade técnica e objetivos de negócio , tomando decisões e conduzindo stakeholders em cenários de pressão e ambiguidade.


No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar o backlog e as entregas de múltiplos clientes estratégicos simultaneamente, garantindo alinhamento com valor de negócio e viabilidade técnica.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre cliente, time técnico e áreas internas, garantindo clareza, alinhamento e fluidez na comunicação.
  • Traduzir necessidades complexas de clientes em soluções estruturadas, considerando impacto, dependências e escalabilidade.
  • Negociar escopo, prazos e trade-offs constantemente, equilibrando velocidade de entrega com qualidade da solução.
  • Mapear integrações, fluxos e dependências entre sistemas internos e parceiros externos.
  • Acompanhar a evolução das entregas, garantindo previsibilidade e mitigação de riscos.
  • Atuar de forma proativa na resolução de problemas, removendo impedimentos e destravando decisões.
  • Contribuir para transformar entregas em cases comerciais relevantes, potencializando o impacto estratégico dos clientes atendidos.


Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência como PM ou PO em produtos digitais, com atuação em contextos complexos e múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Vivência em ambientes com forte interação com clientes (B2B), incluindo negociação de escopo, prazos e expectativas.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas iniciativas simultaneamente sem perder visão de prioridade e impacto.
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para discutir soluções com engenharia, incluindo conceitos de APIs, integrações, frontend, backend e arquitetura.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises e consultas em bases de dados (SQL, MongoDB ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jira, Confluence ou equivalentes.
  • Excelente comunicação, com habilidade para transitar entre áreas técnicas, comerciais e operacionais.


Perfil que buscamos:

  • Pessoa com senso de responsabilidade sobre resultado, não apenas entrega.
  • Capacidade de puxar stakeholders e liderar discussões, sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Habilidade para tomar decisões em cenários de ambiguidade e pressão.
  • Visão sistêmica, entendendo impactos além do escopo imediato.
  • Equilíbrio entre pragmatismo (entregar) e qualidade (sustentar no longo prazo).
  • Organização e clareza para lidar com múltiplos clientes e frentes ao mesmo tempo.


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência com integrações com adquirentes, gateways de pagamento, TEF ou sistemas fiscais.
  • Vivência com parceiros externos e integrações complexas (ex: redes, eventos, grandes operações).
  • Experiência com PDVs, ERP de varejo, soluções para food service ou eventos.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e capacidade de transformar entregas em aprendizados e oportunidades de evolução.


O que oferecemos:

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos com alto impacto no negócio e visibilidade interna.
  • Contato direto com grandes clientes e participação ativa na construção de soluções relevantes.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e espaço para tomada de decisão.
  • Time técnico experiente e colaborativo.
  • Flexibilidade de atuação (remoto ou híbrido).


Mais informações:

  • Possuir CNPJ ativo (nosso modelo de contratação é PJ - Prestador de Serviço).


Acha que é essa vaga é pra você? Não perca tempo e venha fazer parte da revolução do varejo com a gente! #vemsereyemaker!

title: Emissor de Viagens Corporativas – Emissão Internacional (Sênior | Sabre)
description:
Agente de Viagens Corporativas – Emissão Aérea Internacional (Sênior)


Grupo TravelCorp – Corporate Travel Solutions


Desde 1994 , a TravelCorp Viagens e Turismo é reconhecida como uma das agências mais respeitadas do mercado de viagens corporativas no Brasil , atendendo empresas nacionais e multinacionais com alto padrão de eficiência, agilidade e personalização.

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Senior Wordpress Developer (Subscription & Circulation Systems)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate WordPress with subscription, paywall, and circulation systems .
  • Build and maintain API integrations between WordPress and external platforms.
  • Ensure reliable synchronization of user data, subscriptions, billing, and content access .
  • Design backend services and middleware to support multi-system communication .
  • Work closely with product and data teams to support subscription and audience workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data flows across systems for performance and reliability.
  • Develop scalable solutions for high-traffic media platforms .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with backend focus.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and distributed systems .
  • Experience with platforms such as Darwin CX and Naviga NCS Circ .
  • Experience with subscription/paywall systems and audience management platforms.
  • Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST/webhooks.
  • Experience integrating WordPress with external SaaS platforms or enterprise systems .
  • Understanding of authentication, data synchronization, and system reliability.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

title: Product Manager (AI features)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.



About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.

SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • Be a part of a high-impact team building industry-defining B2B software and AI tools.
  • Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package.
  • Remote-friendly and flexible work culture.


About The Role:

At SpendHound, we are on a mission to help Finance and Procurement teams gain real-time visibility and control over their software costs. Our platform simplifies software spend tracking and provides actionable insights, delivering cost-savings to 1000+ companies around the world.

We are building towards an agent-first approach to vendor selection and price benchmarking and are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead the development of new AI features on our roadmap. You will help define the product vision, collaborate with engineering and design teams, and work closely with customers to achieve this goal. This role is ideal for someone looking for a high degree of ownership and passionate about building tools that help business operate more effectively.


As Our Product Manager, You Will:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for SpendHound’s new AI features.
  • Market & User Research: Conduct user interviews, analyze customer feedback, and study market trends to identify opportunities for product enhancements.
  • Feature Development: Work closely with engineering, design, and procurement expert teams to build a world-class vendor intelligence platform.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring product decisions align with real user needs and business objectives.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in Product Management with 1+ years of experience building AI products.
  • Ability to work closely with engineers in a highly technical environment to deliver AI features.
  • Strong ability to translate customer pain points into impactful product features.
  • Comfortable analyzing data, doing error analysis, and using insights to guide product decisions.
  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and procurement expert teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment and drive projects from concept to launch.


Nice To Have:

  • Previous experience with working on B2B products .
  • Experience with Claude, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools.
  • Understanding of the software purchasing process within large organizations.
  • Familiarity with SQL, data visualization tools, or basic coding knowledge


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
About the Company

Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting ecommerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization. We're a specialist e-commerce and creative strategy firm that uses AI-augmented engineering and our CDN engineering heritage to deliver high-performance, scalable digital retail experiences that deliver exceptional revenue performance and growth. Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.



About the Role

We design and ship headless commerce frontends for major retail brands — high-traffic storefronts where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly impacts conversion rates and revenue. You'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams: designing front-end architectures, breaking epics into implementable stories, establishing the coding standards that keep a multi-team codebase coherent, and resolving ambiguity before it reaches a sprint. You'll work directly with clients during discovery and sprint planning, partner with leads and senior engineers through design reviews and ADRs, and collaborate async-first across time zones. The path leads to Principal Architecture with client-facing strategic influence across our commerce practice.


Responsibilities

  • Design and own front-end architectures using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for enterprise commerce implementations
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity
  • Lead architectural decisions on rendering strategies, state management, caching, and performance optimization — and document them in ADRs
  • Drive Core Web Vitals performance across your delivery team, establishing standards engineers build against in every PR
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably
  • Collaborate with clients during discovery to translate business needs into scalable, pragmatic architecture roadmaps
  • Resolve technical ambiguity before sprint — unblocking engineers and escalating architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation

Qualifications

  • Proven architectural experience designing front-end systems and leading distributed engineering teams (3+ people)
  • Deep proficiency in Next.js (App Router, React Server Components), React, TypeScript, and modern web architecture — SSR strategies, edge computing, serverless patterns
  • Performance engineering expertise: Core Web Vitals optimization, CDN configuration, caching strategies, and a track record of shipping measurable improvements
  • Strong written and verbal English — you'll align technical work with client expectations, explain architectural tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, and define the conventions engineers build against
  • Evidence of designing work for agentic operation — not just personal AI tool usage, but structuring how teams work with agents: writing specs agents can execute, maintaining documentation as context infrastructure, and decomposing features so that agent-generated output is reviewable and reliable


Required Skills

  • Familiarity with commerce platforms (Shopify Storefront API, SFCC Composable Storefront, Big Commerce)
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Contentstack)


Preferred Skills

  • Tools: React, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Shopify Plus / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Big Commerce / SCAYLE
  • Vercel, CI/CD pipelines
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code, ChatGPT
  • Jest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence


What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company.
  • AI: Premium AI tooling licenses (Cursor and/or Claude Code) for your entire team, with organizational support for building AI-first delivery practices.



Equal Opportunity Statement

Space Dinosaurs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Customer Support & Operations Specialist
description:
OysterLink is the fastest-growing restaurant & hospitality job site . The site recently launched and is generating over 350,000 monthly visitors organically.


We are seeking a forward-facing Customer Support & Operations Specialist with excellent English communication and organizational skills for:


  • Client & Applicant Communication
  • Platform Management & Issue Resolution
  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement


Required Skills:


  • Excellent English speaking skills and excellent grammar and communication skills
  • Attention to detail and ability to learn platform features
  • Strong customer service focus, ability to troubleshoot issues and come up with solutions
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively
  • Experience in ticket management & documenting feedback
  • Able to work between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. EST as we target a US demographic


The GOALS for this position is to:


  • Keep client response time during work hours under 1 hour, and issue resolution time under 2 hours
  • Ensure client feedback (bugs or improvements) is documented, logged, and plan resolutions for all client feedback (bugs or improvements) on the day it arrives


Responsibilities:


Client & Applicant Communication

  • Provide prompt support for inquiries, respond to questions, and offer guidance
  • Communicate effectively with companies and job seekers


Platform Management & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot feature issues, monitor bug/support requests
  • Refresh and reorder featured job listings on our site and LinkedIn


Feedback & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and share client/applicant feedback with internal teams to enhance platform features


Prior to platform launch (on the current site)

  • Manage incoming “Post a Job” submissions
  • Gather missing information and confirm postings with clients
  • Collect and review CVs


The ideal candidate must be a proactive and independent thinker who can take ownership of the tasks at hand and ensure timely & quality output through collaboration with other team members.


Oyster Link offers competitive salaries, yearly growth opportunities AND profit sharing .


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position. We do require team members who can work up until 5 pm EST.


What we offer at OysterLink:

  • A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth
  • Job stability and growth
  • Profit Sharing
  • Shares in the company to receive an earn-out when the company is sold
  • Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members
  • Work-from-home opportunity
  • 4 weeks paid time off


We are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Receive Test
  • Have an interview with our Hiring Manager
  • Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Analista de Produto Júnior (Vibecoder)
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Procuramos um estudante ou recém-formado em Economia (ou áreas correlatas) que queira acelerar sua entrada no mercado de tecnologia através da Inteligência Artificial Operacional.

Você não será um programador focado em sintaxe tradicional, mas um Vibecoder: um profissional que utiliza o poder do Claude Code e agentes de IA para construir, gerenciar e escalar serviços de dados reais na nuvem.

O que você vai fazer (The Vibe)

● Vibe Coding: Operar o Claude Code para conectar repositórios no GitHub, baixar skills e automatizar processos de dados com velocidade de IA.

● Gestão de Cloud: Supervisionar e configurar a infraestrutura no Google Cloud (Functions, Run, BigQuery) com o apoio das nossas ferramentas.

● Curadoria de UX: Sabemos que você não é designer e não esperamos que saiba usar ferramentas de desenho. Nós vamos te treinar para desenvolver um senso crítico apurado sobre hierarquia de informação. Seu papel será supervisionar e guiar as IAs para que o produto final seja útil, claro e eficiente para o usuário.

Perfil do Candidato

● Background Analítico (Economia/Exatas): Capacidade de entender a lógica de custos, incentivos e eficiência de processos.

● Mindset Pragmático: Foco em resolver o problema do cliente da forma mais inteligente e automatizada possível.

● Curiosidade Tecnológica: Vontade de dominar o ecossistema Google Cloud e ferramentas de \"coding-by-chat\".

● Vontade de Aprender: Disposição para passar pelo nosso treinamento proprietário de UX e Cloud.

O que oferecemos

● Treinamento de Elite: Acesso ao nosso Gem de IA, um tutor exclusivo que te guiará passo a passo em Cloud, Vibe Coding e Design Crítico.

● Cultura AI-First: Ambiente onde a produtividade via IA é a regra, não a exceção.

● Autonomia Real: Espaço para gerenciar produtos de dados e influenciar decisões de arquitetura e interface.



Benefícios:

Assistência Médica e odontológica · Seguro de Vida · Vale Alimentação/Refeição · Gympass ️ · 3 Days Off por ano

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Sobre a empresa:

  • Empresa multinacional do setor Financeiro até Logística para marcas de consumo nos EUA e na UE.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Supervisionar a alocação de estoque para pedidos B2B de múltiplas marcas que operam nos EUA e na Europa
  • Projetar a disponibilidade de estoque e fornecer visibilidade dos prazos futuros de entrega com base nos recebimentos de estoque
  • Recomendar ajustes ou extensões nos prazos das janelas de entrega para pedidos ou grupos de produtos, conforme a disponibilidade de estoque
  • Coordenar com o financeiro para garantir que os pedidos sejam liberados para cobrança antes dos embarques
  • Liberar pedidos para os armazéns com base nas janelas de entrega e garantir que as priorizações estejam alinhadas às necessidades do negócio
  • Colaborar com o especialista de logística outbound para acompanhar as prioridades diárias e o progresso junto aos 3PLs
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para as equipes de vendas dos clientes, fornecendo atualizações de status, ajustes e feedback sobre os pedidos


O que você precisa ter:

  • Fluente em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito
  • Pessoa proativa, orientada a soluções e focada em escalabilidade
  • Experiência em alocação de pedidos, customer success ou gestão da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Tem vontade de aprender a dinâmica de gerenciar múltiplos clientes e varejistas em diferentes países
  • Possui fortes habilidades organizacionais, de comunicação e de resolução de problemas, com grande atenção aos detalhes
  • Tem familiaridade com operações de 3PL, sistemas de gestão de pedidos ou ferramentas de planejamento de inventário (diferencial)
  • Sabe gerenciar prioridades e se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança


Observações:

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ

title: Product Manager (AI features)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.



About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.

SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • Be a part of a high-impact team building industry-defining B2B software and AI tools.
  • Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package.
  • Remote-friendly and flexible work culture.


About The Role:

At SpendHound, we are on a mission to help Finance and Procurement teams gain real-time visibility and control over their software costs. Our platform simplifies software spend tracking and provides actionable insights, delivering cost-savings to 1000+ companies around the world.

We are building towards an agent-first approach to vendor selection and price benchmarking and are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead the development of new AI features on our roadmap. You will help define the product vision, collaborate with engineering and design teams, and work closely with customers to achieve this goal. This role is ideal for someone looking for a high degree of ownership and passionate about building tools that help business operate more effectively.


As Our Product Manager, You Will:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for SpendHound’s new AI features.
  • Market & User Research: Conduct user interviews, analyze customer feedback, and study market trends to identify opportunities for product enhancements.
  • Feature Development: Work closely with engineering, design, and procurement expert teams to build a world-class vendor intelligence platform.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring product decisions align with real user needs and business objectives.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in Product Management with 1+ years of experience building AI products.
  • Ability to work closely with engineers in a highly technical environment to deliver AI features.
  • Strong ability to translate customer pain points into impactful product features.
  • Comfortable analyzing data, doing error analysis, and using insights to guide product decisions.
  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and procurement expert teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment and drive projects from concept to launch.


Nice To Have:

  • Previous experience with working on B2B products .
  • Experience with Claude, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools.
  • Understanding of the software purchasing process within large organizations.
  • Familiarity with SQL, data visualization tools, or basic coding knowledge


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer (Motion) with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion.


You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentation and motion graphics.


This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation and smart use of AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.



What you’ll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements - including transitions, text animations, graphics packages and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.



What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.



Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility - powered by smart tech, streamlined systems and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative and be part of a modern creative operation - we’d love to hear from you.



Benefits

  • USD-based compensation
  • Work from anywhere

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).
  • Knowledge of monitoring/logging tools (App Insights, CloudWatch, DataDog).
  • Experience with performance profiling



This is a CLT Role at R$18,000/month
