With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.



About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.

SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • Be a part of a high-impact team building industry-defining B2B software and AI tools.
  • Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package.
  • Remote-friendly and flexible work culture.


About The Role:

At SpendHound, we are on a mission to help Finance and Procurement teams gain real-time visibility and control over their software costs. Our platform simplifies software spend tracking and provides actionable insights, delivering cost-savings to 1000+ companies around the world.

We are building towards an agent-first approach to vendor selection and price benchmarking and are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead the development of new AI features on our roadmap. You will help define the product vision, collaborate with engineering and design teams, and work closely with customers to achieve this goal. This role is ideal for someone looking for a high degree of ownership and passionate about building tools that help business operate more effectively.


As Our Product Manager, You Will:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for SpendHound’s new AI features.
  • Market & User Research: Conduct user interviews, analyze customer feedback, and study market trends to identify opportunities for product enhancements.
  • Feature Development: Work closely with engineering, design, and procurement expert teams to build a world-class vendor intelligence platform.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring product decisions align with real user needs and business objectives.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in Product Management with 1+ years of experience building AI products.
  • Ability to work closely with engineers in a highly technical environment to deliver AI features.
  • Strong ability to translate customer pain points into impactful product features.
  • Comfortable analyzing data, doing error analysis, and using insights to guide product decisions.
  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and procurement expert teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment and drive projects from concept to launch.


Nice To Have:

  • Previous experience with working on B2B products .
  • Experience with Claude, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools.
  • Understanding of the software purchasing process within large organizations.
  • Familiarity with SQL, data visualization tools, or basic coding knowledge


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Wordpress Developer (Subscription & Circulation Systems)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate WordPress with subscription, paywall, and circulation systems .
  • Build and maintain API integrations between WordPress and external platforms.
  • Ensure reliable synchronization of user data, subscriptions, billing, and content access .
  • Design backend services and middleware to support multi-system communication .
  • Work closely with product and data teams to support subscription and audience workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data flows across systems for performance and reliability.
  • Develop scalable solutions for high-traffic media platforms .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with backend focus.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and distributed systems .
  • Experience with platforms such as Darwin CX and Naviga NCS Circ .
  • Experience with subscription/paywall systems and audience management platforms.
  • Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST/webhooks.
  • Experience integrating WordPress with external SaaS platforms or enterprise systems .
  • Understanding of authentication, data synchronization, and system reliability.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Duration: 6months

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions
  • Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows
  • Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights
  • Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes
  • Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring
  • Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
  • Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
  • Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
  • Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
  • Flow Builder (must-have)
  • Reports & Dashboards
  • Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
  • Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
  • Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules)
  • Experience with data quality and governance
  • Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level)
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills


Primary Skills

1.Salesforce Platform hands-on experience

2.Salesforce admin expertise (Security Model, Data Model, End to End configuration, Flows etc)

3. Salesforce Admin Cert

4. Reports & Dashboards – Handson


Secondary Skills

1. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud

2. Business analysis

3. Stakeholder Management

title: Product Manager – Clientes Estratégicos
description:
Venha integrar um time de excelência, somos a Eyemobile uma startup que nasceu para revolucionar o varejo! ✨


Nossa missão é simplificar a forma como negócios vendem através de inovação e tecnologia.


Estamos há 12 anos no mercado, e em nossa história, temos muitos aprendizados e conquistas, que nos ajudaram a construir uma cultura sólida, com base em três pilares: o Cuidar, Imaginar e Simplificar. Tudo isso pensando em nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e na tecnologia.


Se você se identifica com valores como: Simplicidade, Agilidade, Confiança, Inovação e Experiência do Cliente , já está há um passo à frente! Então, continue lendo para conhecer mais sobre essa oportunidade que pode mudar sua carreira!


➡️ Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Manager para atuar na frente de Clientes Estratégicos , liderando a entrega e evolução de soluções em contextos de alta complexidade, múltiplas integrações e forte impacto comercial.


Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar um portfólio de clientes relevantes, atuando de forma end-to-end — desde o entendimento do problema até a entrega em produção — com responsabilidade direta sobre o sucesso das iniciativas.


Aqui, não buscamos um perfil focado apenas em backlog ou execução. Procuramos alguém com ownership, capaz de equilibrar demandas de clientes, viabilidade técnica e objetivos de negócio , tomando decisões e conduzindo stakeholders em cenários de pressão e ambiguidade.


No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar o backlog e as entregas de múltiplos clientes estratégicos simultaneamente, garantindo alinhamento com valor de negócio e viabilidade técnica.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre cliente, time técnico e áreas internas, garantindo clareza, alinhamento e fluidez na comunicação.
  • Traduzir necessidades complexas de clientes em soluções estruturadas, considerando impacto, dependências e escalabilidade.
  • Negociar escopo, prazos e trade-offs constantemente, equilibrando velocidade de entrega com qualidade da solução.
  • Mapear integrações, fluxos e dependências entre sistemas internos e parceiros externos.
  • Acompanhar a evolução das entregas, garantindo previsibilidade e mitigação de riscos.
  • Atuar de forma proativa na resolução de problemas, removendo impedimentos e destravando decisões.
  • Contribuir para transformar entregas em cases comerciais relevantes, potencializando o impacto estratégico dos clientes atendidos.


Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência como PM ou PO em produtos digitais, com atuação em contextos complexos e múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Vivência em ambientes com forte interação com clientes (B2B), incluindo negociação de escopo, prazos e expectativas.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas iniciativas simultaneamente sem perder visão de prioridade e impacto.
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para discutir soluções com engenharia, incluindo conceitos de APIs, integrações, frontend, backend e arquitetura.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises e consultas em bases de dados (SQL, MongoDB ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jira, Confluence ou equivalentes.
  • Excelente comunicação, com habilidade para transitar entre áreas técnicas, comerciais e operacionais.


Perfil que buscamos:

  • Pessoa com senso de responsabilidade sobre resultado, não apenas entrega.

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
About the Company

Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting ecommerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization. We're a specialist e-commerce and creative strategy firm that uses AI-augmented engineering and our CDN engineering heritage to deliver high-performance, scalable digital retail experiences that deliver exceptional revenue performance and growth. Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.



About the Role

We design and ship headless commerce frontends for major retail brands — high-traffic storefronts where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly impacts conversion rates and revenue. You'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams: designing front-end architectures, breaking epics into implementable stories, establishing the coding standards that keep a multi-team codebase coherent, and resolving ambiguity before it reaches a sprint. You'll work directly with clients during discovery and sprint planning, partner with leads and senior engineers through design reviews and ADRs, and collaborate async-first across time zones. The path leads to Principal Architecture with client-facing strategic influence across our commerce practice.


Responsibilities

  • Design and own front-end architectures using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for enterprise commerce implementations
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity
  • Lead architectural decisions on rendering strategies, state management, caching, and performance optimization — and document them in ADRs
  • Drive Core Web Vitals performance across your delivery team, establishing standards engineers build against in every PR
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably
  • Collaborate with clients during discovery to translate business needs into scalable, pragmatic architecture roadmaps
  • Resolve technical ambiguity before sprint — unblocking engineers and escalating architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation

Qualifications

  • Proven architectural experience designing front-end systems and leading distributed engineering teams (3+ people)
  • Deep proficiency in Next.js (App Router, React Server Components), React, TypeScript, and modern web architecture — SSR strategies, edge computing, serverless patterns
  • Performance engineering expertise: Core Web Vitals optimization, CDN configuration, caching strategies, and a track record of shipping measurable improvements
  • Strong written and verbal English — you'll align technical work with client expectations, explain architectural tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, and define the conventions engineers build against
  • Evidence of designing work for agentic operation — not just personal AI tool usage, but structuring how teams work with agents: writing specs agents can execute, maintaining documentation as context infrastructure, and decomposing features so that agent-generated output is reviewable and reliable


Required Skills

  • Familiarity with commerce platforms (Shopify Storefront API, SFCC Composable Storefront, Big Commerce)
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Contentstack)


Preferred Skills

  • Tools: React, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Shopify Plus / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Big Commerce / SCAYLE
  • Vercel, CI/CD pipelines
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code, ChatGPT
  • Jest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence


What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company.
  • AI: Premium AI tooling licenses (Cursor and/or Claude Code) for your entire team, with organizational support for building AI-first delivery practices.



Equal Opportunity Statement

Space Dinosaurs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).
  • Knowledge of monitoring/logging tools (App Insights, CloudWatch, DataDog).
  • Experience with performance profiling

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Customer Support & Operations Specialist
description:
OysterLink is the fastest-growing restaurant & hospitality job site . The site recently launched and is generating over 350,000 monthly visitors organically.


We are seeking a forward-facing Customer Support & Operations Specialist with excellent English communication and organizational skills for:


  • Client & Applicant Communication
  • Platform Management & Issue Resolution
  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement


Required Skills:


  • Excellent English speaking skills and excellent grammar and communication skills
  • Attention to detail and ability to learn platform features
  • Strong customer service focus, ability to troubleshoot issues and come up with solutions
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively
  • Experience in ticket management & documenting feedback
  • Able to work between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. EST as we target a US demographic


The GOALS for this position is to:


  • Keep client response time during work hours under 1 hour, and issue resolution time under 2 hours
  • Ensure client feedback (bugs or improvements) is documented, logged, and plan resolutions for all client feedback (bugs or improvements) on the day it arrives


Responsibilities:


Client & Applicant Communication

  • Provide prompt support for inquiries, respond to questions, and offer guidance
  • Communicate effectively with companies and job seekers


Platform Management & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot feature issues, monitor bug/support requests
  • Refresh and reorder featured job listings on our site and LinkedIn


Feedback & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and share client/applicant feedback with internal teams to enhance platform features


Prior to platform launch (on the current site)

  • Manage incoming “Post a Job” submissions
  • Gather missing information and confirm postings with clients
  • Collect and review CVs


The ideal candidate must be a proactive and independent thinker who can take ownership of the tasks at hand and ensure timely & quality output through collaboration with other team members.


Oyster Link offers competitive salaries, yearly growth opportunities AND profit sharing .


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position. We do require team members who can work up until 5 pm EST.


What we offer at OysterLink:

  • A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth
  • Job stability and growth
  • Profit Sharing
  • Shares in the company to receive an earn-out when the company is sold
  • Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members
  • Work-from-home opportunity
  • 4 weeks paid time off


We are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Receive Test
  • Have an interview with our Hiring Manager
  • Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.

Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.

●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.

●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.


Requisitos e qualificações:


●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.

●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.

●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.

●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

Senior Software Engineer

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Job Summary


As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. title: Consultor SAP BRIM
description:
Consultor SAP BRIM – Convergent Charging

Início: imediato.

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado.

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto.

Horário de trabalho: 9h00 às 18h00.

Idioma: Inglês avançado.


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um Consultor SAP BRIM Sênior com forte experiência em SAP Convergent Charging (CC) para atuação em projetos e sustentação de soluções de billing e charging em ambientes de alta volumetria. O profissional será responsável pela modelagem, configuração e operação de cenários complexos de tarifação em tempo real e batch, integrando os componentes do SAP BRIM, como SOM, CI, FI-CA, e sistemas externos, como mediation, billing e CRM.


A posição envolve participação em implementações end-to-end, melhorias evolutivas e AMS, com forte atuação em desenho de solução, troubleshooting avançado, análise de performance e suporte à arquitetura BRIM.


Principais responsabilidades:


• Desenho e configuração de modelos de charging no SAP Convergent Charging.

• Criação e manutenção de Charge Plans, Charging Contexts, Price Plans e Charging Trees.

• Implementação de cenários de rating em tempo real (online charging) e batch (offline charging).

• Integração do SAP CC com SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), SAP SOM e sistemas externos.

• Integração via Web Services, APIs e mediation systems.

• Troubleshooting de problemas de rating, inconsistências de consumo e performance de charging.

• Análise de logs e tuning de performance.

• Suporte a testes unitários, integrados e UAT.

• Participação na definição de arquitetura BRIM.

• Suporte em atividades de cutover e hypercare.

• Atuação tanto em projetos de implementação quanto em AMS/sustentação.


Requisitos Técnicos


• 6 a 8+ anos de experiência em SAP

• Pelo menos 3+ anos de experiência em SAP BRIM / Convergent Charging

• Experiência em pelo menos uma implementação end-to-end de BRIM.

• Conhecimento sólido de SAP BRIM (arquitetura end-to-end);

• Experiência avançada em SAP Convergent Charging (CC);

• Experiência com modelagem de pricing e rating.

• Experiência com integração entre SAP CC, SOM, CI, FI-CA e sistemas externos.

• Conhecimento de billing para telecom ou utilities.

• Experiência com Web Services, APIs e arquitetura distribuída.

• Experiência com análise de dados de alta volumetria e performance tuning.

• Forte experiência em troubleshooting e análise de logs.


Diferenciais


• Experiência com SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management);

• Conhecimento em SAP CI e FI-CA.

• Experiência com cenários pré-pagos e pós-pagos.

• Experiência em ambientes de grande escala (telecom ou utilities).


Competências Comportamentais


• Perfil analítico e orientado à solução.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

• Proatividade e autonomia;

• Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão;

• Organização e visão sistêmica


Perfil Profissional Esperado


Profissional sênior, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente em ambientes BRIM complexos, contribuindo com desenho de solução, sustentação de ambientes de alta volumetria e atuando como referência técnica em SAP Convergent Charging dentro do projeto ou operação.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

title: Senior Back-end Architect (Python)
description:
I’m helping Staffinit find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Senior Back-end Architect (Python) .


You'll architect high-performance AI evaluation systems, directly impacting customer experience at scale.


Compensation:

USD 46.2 - 59.8/hour.


Location:

Remote (specific timezones).


Mission of Staffinit:

\"Our mission: to connect talent. empower businesses. We work with clients across industries, helping them build teams that make a difference, and support professionals in finding roles where they can thrive. At our core, we combine deep recruitment expertise with a human-centred approach—ensuring that each placement aligns skills, culture and ambition.

\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You are proficient in REST API, Query optimization, Event-driven architecture (EDA), Data modeling.
  • You have +3 years experience in Python, Asynchronous programming.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python) at the Architect / Team Leader / Principal Engineer level to collaborate with our Customer.


Project:

- The project is being carried out for a German client and involves building an evaluation platform — a key system enabling the testing of AI agents through simulated scenarios and monitoring of performance results.


Role in the Project:

- The Senior Python Backend Engineer will collaborate with an internal development team and technical leads.

- The role includes full ownership of building and developing solutions and deploying them to production environments.

- Microservices must be high-performance, low-latency, scalable, and reliable.


Candidate Expectations:

- A combination of deep Python knowledge with system design skills, architectural thinking, independence, and proactivity.

- Strong sense of ownership.

- Strong communication skills.

- Independence in designing and evolving system architecture.

- These solutions directly impact the quality of experience for customers testing and deploying AI agents at scale.


Collaboration Model:

- Contract through end of 2026 with a high likelihood of extension.

- Remote work (100% FTE).

- Project team of 4–5 people based in Poland.

- Occasional visits to the Berlin office possible.


Team Office Meetings:

- The client organizes so-called in-office weeks — typically 3–5 days in the office, approximately twice per quarter.

- We try to schedule these flexibly around the team.

- Part of the team works from the UK and also joins these meetings.

- Attendance is not mandatory but is appreciated for collaboration and team building.


Requirements:

Python and Backend:

- Strong knowledge of modern Python, at least 3 years of experience with versions 3.10 and above (asyncio, concurrency, asynchronous programming).

- Experience building backend services running in production environments, 7+ years expected.


System Design and Maintenance:

- Designing and implementing REST APIs.

- Designing scalable distributed systems.

- Experience with event-driven architecture or task queue-based systems.

- Designing fault-tolerant and overload-resistant systems.

- Experience maintaining production systems.


Data Processing and Persistence:

- Production experience with databases (NoSQL, MongoDB preferred).

- Data modeling, schema management, migrations.

- Query and database structure optimization.


Concurrency and Task Processing:

- Background task processing architecture.

- Handling long-running and parallel tasks.

- Worker models and process isolation.


Engineering Ownership and Communication:

- End-to-end ownership of delivered solutions — from analyzing and verifying requirements, designing architecture, through to production deployment.

- Ability to make technical decisions, analyze and address risks.

- Good English communication skills.


Nice to Have:

Python Ecosystem:

- FastAPI or other async web frameworks.

- Pydantic and type-based validation.

- Static type checking (mypy).


Distributed and Event-Driven Systems:

- Kafka or similar streaming systems.

- Task queuing and load distribution systems.

- Multi-tenant system design.


Cloud and Containerization:

- Kubernetes and container deployments.

- CI/CD and deployment automation.


System Observability:

- Distributed tracing systems (e.g. OpenTelemetry).

- Metrics-based monitoring and SLOs.


Performance and Scaling:

- High-throughput systems.

- Load balancing and queue sharding.


AI / LLM Integrations:

- Integration with language model APIs.

- Designing evaluation and scoring pipelines.

- Managing rate limits and model query costs.


Work Environment and Tooling:

Backend and Infrastructure:

- FastAPI, Uvicorn,

- MongoDB (Motor).

- Redis (task queues).

- Kafka / Azure Event Hubs.

- Kong as middleware layer for LLM integrations.


Observability and Monitoring:

- OpenTelemetry.

- Datadog.

- Structured logging and trace correlation.


Delivery and Infrastructure:

- Kubernetes and Helm.

- Docker (multi-stage builds).

- GitHub Actions (CI/CD).

- ArgoCD (GitOps).


Python Tooling:

- UV (dependency management).

- Ruff, mypy.

- Pytest, testcontainers.


AI Integrations:

- OpenAI SDK and structured model responses.

- LLM Gateway architecture.

- Token usage and rate limit control.

title: Head of Artificial Intelligence
description:
A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil.

Estamos construindo a próxima geração de software financeiro — com forte uso de IA aplicada a problemas reais, complexos e críticos.

Buscamos alguém para liderar essa evolução do ponto de vista técnico.


  • O desafio

Você será responsável por desenhar e liderar a construção de sistemas de decisão baseados em IA aplicados ao contexto financeiro.

Isso inclui desde interpretação de dados não estruturados até automação de fluxos críticos com alto nível de confiabilidade.


Essa não é uma vaga para trabalhar com IA. É uma vaga para construir sistemas que tomam decisões reais em produção.


  • Responsabilidades
  • Definir a arquitetura de sistemas baseados em IA (LLMs + lógica determinística)
  • Construir pipelines de processamento de dados (estruturados e não estruturados)
  • Desenvolver mecanismos de decisão automatizada com controle de risco
  • Projetar sistemas robustos, com:
  • fallback
  • validação
  • auditabilidade
  • Trabalhar próximo do time de engenharia para garantir escalabilidade e performance
  • Definir métricas e melhorar continuamente:
  • precisão
  • custo
  • confiabilidade


  • O que buscamos
  • Experiência real colocando sistemas de IA em produção (não apenas protótipos)
  • Forte capacidade de system design
  • Experiência com:
  • LLMs e/ou modelos de NLP
  • pipelines de dados
  • sistemas backend (APIs, filas, processamento assíncrono)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões pragmáticas (quando usar AI vs quando não usar)
  • Mentalidade de produto (impacto > perfeição)


  • Diferenciais
  • Experiência com dados financeiros ou sistemas críticos
  • Já construiu sistemas com alto requisito de confiabilidade
  • Experiência com avaliação e melhoria contínua de modelos
  • Consegue explicar trade-offs técnicos de forma clara


  • O que não buscamos
  • Perfis focados apenas em prompt engineering
  • Experiência apenas acadêmica ou experimental
  • Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção


  • Remuneração
  • Contrato PJ
  • Faixa: R$ 35k – R$ 45k/mês


  • Processo
  • Conversa inicial
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Case prático

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Junior Lighting Designer - Remote

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Staff Engineer — Payfy

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.

Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.


Atividades:


●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento.

●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região.

●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final.

●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.

●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.


Requisitos e qualificações:


●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.

●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.

●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.

●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Senior Security Analyst OR Senior Information Security Analyst (GRC)
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Support security governance, risk assessments, and audit activities (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.)
  • Monitor security metrics and identify compliance gaps or risks
  • Track and drive remediation of security issues with application and platform teams
  • Ensure security controls are effectively designed and implemented
  • Prepare reports and communicate risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance security processes and controls

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience in information security, IT risk, compliance, or audit roles
  • Strong understanding of frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, or similar
  • Experience supporting audits, assurance activities, and remediation efforts
  • Familiarity with security metrics, control monitoring, and SLA-based compliance
  • Experience working with system or application owners to resolve security issues
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills for risk and compliance tracking
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Knowledge of cloud, SaaS, or enterprise platforms
  • Hands-on experience with security tools such as Panaseer, Checkmarx, or Wiz

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CRISC, or CISSP (or in progress)
  • Experience in regulated or data-driven environments
  • Familiarity with privacy, data protection, or third-party risk management

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Desenvolvedor Eixir
description:

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Desenvolvedor(a) Elixir com sólida experiência para integrar nosso time dedicado a um projeto estratégico na área de crédito. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções robustas e escaláveis, com foco em validação de usuários e autenticação, garantindo segurança e desempenho das aplicações.

Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações utilizando a linguagem Elixir.

Implementar soluções para validação de usuários e autenticação, seguindo as melhores práticas de segurança.

Participar de discussões técnicas para definição de arquitetura e estratégias de desenvolvimento.

Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros membros da SQUAD, incluindo PO, QA, e DevOps.

Garantir a qualidade do código e a aderência às políticas de desenvolvimento do cliente.

Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento com Elixir e o Phoenix Framework

Familiaridade com Ecto para manipulação de dados e interação com bancos de dados.

Experiência em implementação de testes com ExUnit e práticas de TDD/BDD.

Compreensão de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e padrões de design.

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL.

Familiaridade com testes automatizados e boas práticas de programação.


Diferenciais:

Experiência em projetos no setor financeiro ou de crédito.

Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Experiência em autenticação multifator (MFA) e Single Sign-On (SSO).

100% remoto

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um corretor de imóveis para integrar a equipe da RE/MAX Capital no Distrito Federal. Esse cargo envolve atividades diárias como atendimento a clientes, realização de visitas a propriedades, intermediação de negociações imobiliárias e gestão de carteira de imóveis. O profissional atuará no formato presencial, promovendo vendas e locações de imóveis residenciais e comerciais com excelência e profissionalismo.

Qualificações

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Proficiente em prestar um atendimento de qualidade e personalizado, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
  • Vendas e Negociação: Capacidade comprovada de realizar vendas e conduzir negociações eficazes, maximizando resultados para todas as partes envolvidas.

title: Head of Artificial Intelligence
description:
A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil.

Estamos construindo a próxima geração de software financeiro — com forte uso de IA aplicada a problemas reais, complexos e críticos.

Buscamos alguém para liderar essa evolução do ponto de vista técnico.


  • O desafio

Você será responsável por desenhar e liderar a construção de sistemas de decisão baseados em IA aplicados ao contexto financeiro.

Isso inclui desde interpretação de dados não estruturados até automação de fluxos críticos com alto nível de confiabilidade.


Essa não é uma vaga para trabalhar com IA. É uma vaga para construir sistemas que tomam decisões reais em produção.


  • Responsabilidades
  • Definir a arquitetura de sistemas baseados em IA (LLMs + lógica determinística)
  • Construir pipelines de processamento de dados (estruturados e não estruturados)
  • Desenvolver mecanismos de decisão automatizada com controle de risco
  • Projetar sistemas robustos, com:
  • fallback
  • validação
  • auditabilidade
  • Trabalhar próximo do time de engenharia para garantir escalabilidade e performance
  • Definir métricas e melhorar continuamente:
  • precisão
  • custo
  • confiabilidade


  • O que buscamos
  • Experiência real colocando sistemas de IA em produção (não apenas protótipos)
  • Forte capacidade de system design
  • Experiência com:
  • LLMs e/ou modelos de NLP
  • pipelines de dados
  • sistemas backend (APIs, filas, processamento assíncrono)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões pragmáticas (quando usar AI vs quando não usar)
  • Mentalidade de produto (impacto > perfeição)


  • Diferenciais
  • Experiência com dados financeiros ou sistemas críticos
  • Já construiu sistemas com alto requisito de confiabilidade
  • Experiência com avaliação e melhoria contínua de modelos
  • Consegue explicar trade-offs técnicos de forma clara


  • O que não buscamos
  • Perfis focados apenas em prompt engineering
  • Experiência apenas acadêmica ou experimental
  • Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção


  • Remuneração
  • Contrato PJ
  • Faixa: R$ 35k – R$ 45k/mês


  • Processo
  • Conversa inicial
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Case prático

title: Sourcer LATAM
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Pleno para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM da AI/R Company, empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.



Você será responsável por:


  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.



O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Consultor SAP BRIM

Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um Consultor SAP BRIM Sênior com forte experiência em SAP Convergent Charging (CC) para atuação em projetos e sustentação de soluções de billing e charging em ambientes de alta volumetria. O profissional será responsável pela modelagem, configuração e operação de cenários complexos de tarifação em tempo real e batch, integrando os componentes do SAP BRIM, como SOM, CI, FI-CA, e sistemas externos, como mediation, billing e CRM.


A posição envolve participação em implementações end-to-end, melhorias evolutivas e AMS, com forte atuação em desenho de solução, troubleshooting avançado, análise de performance e suporte à arquitetura BRIM.

Diferenciais

• Conhecimento em SAP CI e FI-CA.

• Experiência com cenários pré-pagos e pós-pagos.

• Experiência em ambientes de grande escala (telecom ou utilities).


Competências Comportamentais

Profissional sênior, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente em ambientes BRIM complexos, contribuindo com desenho de solução, sustentação de ambientes de alta volumetria e atuando como referência técnica em SAP Convergent Charging dentro do projeto ou operação.
