title: Principal Data Platform Architect (Spark / Big Data / Distributed Systems)
description:
Location: Remote

Company: Daivio

Level: Staff / Principal / Architect




About Us

We’re building Daivio — an AI-native data platform where users can interact with their data like they interact with AI.

We are tackling a hard problem:

Making large-scale data processing intuitive, fast, and intelligent.

This means solving serious distributed systems challenges .




The Role

We are looking for a world-class Data Architect / Engineer who has built and scaled real big data systems .

This is not about dashboards.

This is about designing the engine behind them .

You will define how data flows, scales, and performs inside Daivio.




What You’ll Do

  • Architect and build large-scale data processing systems
  • Design and optimize Apache Spark workloads (batch + streaming)
  • Own the architecture for:
  • data ingestion
  • transformation
  • storage
  • query layers
  • Build high-performance data pipelines handling large volumes
  • Optimize for:
  • latency
  • throughput
  • cost
  • Design distributed systems that don’t fall apart at scale
  • Work closely with AI/ML layers to enable intelligent data interaction
  • Make foundational architecture decisions




What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has deep, hands-on Apache Spark expertise (not just usage – internals matter)
  • Understands distributed systems fundamentals (partitioning, shuffling, fault tolerance)
  • Has built or scaled data platforms handling large datasets
  • Knows trade-offs between:
  • batch vs streaming
  • compute vs storage
  • latency vs cost
  • Thinks in systems, not tools
  • Has strong opinions about data architecture patterns
  • Can operate with high ownership and zero hand-holding




Tech Stack (Current & Evolving)

  • Apache Spark (core component)
  • Distributed data processing (batch + streaming)
  • Data lakes / lakehouse architectures
  • Python / Scala
  • Cloud (Azure preferred)
  • Kubernetes-based execution environments




Why This Role is Different

  • You are not plugging into an existing system — you are defining it
  • You will shape how AI interacts with data at scale
  • You will solve non-trivial distributed systems problems daily
  • You will work directly with founders on core architecture




What We Offer

  • High ownership, zero bureaucracy
  • Real technical influence
  • The chance to build a category-defining data platform




Who This Is NOT For

  • People who only used Spark via notebooks
  • People without production-scale experience
  • People who optimize for comfort over impact




How to Apply

Send:

  • LinkedIn / CV
  • Short note: What is the hardest data system you’ve built and why?



We’re building for scale from day one. If you’ve done it before, we want to talk.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: Project Manager and Analyst
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a high-impact Project Manager & Analyst who thrives at the intersection of data-driven insights and operational excellence.

You will be the driving engine of our project executions, responsible for translating complex data into actionable project plans and managing relevant stakeholder, client, and executive communications.


Key Responsibilities


1. Project Management

  • End-to-End Oversight: Lead cross-functional projects from initial scoping through to final delivery, ensuring timelines and quality benchmarks are met.
  • Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in our current workflows and design scalable solutions to improve efficiency across the organization. Author standard operating procedures (SOPs) and forms.
  • Resource Allocation: Monitor project health and adjust resources dynamically to meet shifting business priorities.


2. Data Analysis & Insights

  • Analytical Rigor: Synthesize large datasets to identify trends, track KPIs, and provide insights that influence company growth.
  • Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility into project performance and departmental goals.
  • Risk Mitigation: Use quality management systems and predictive analysis to identify potential project risks before they impact the bottom line.


3. Executive Communication

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary bridge between clients, technical, operations teams and the executive suite.
  • Presentations: Craft compelling narratives and slide decks for leadership meetings, distilling complex project statuses into clear, high-level summaries.
  • Alignment: Ensure all project goals are tightly aligned with Medcase’s overarching commercial and clinical objectives.


Who You Are

  • A Master of Organization: You use project management principles, like Agile methodologies and tools to optimize processes.
  • Analytically Minded: You are comfortable with SQL, Google Sheets, AppScript, Looker Studio and possess a natural curiosity to dig into the \"why\" behind the numbers.
  • An Exceptional Communicator: You know how to be concise, persuasive, and professional. Present your ideas and insights using storytelling and with ease.
  • Proactive: You don't wait for a roadmap; you help build it.


Qualifications


Experience

3–5 years in Project Management, Business Analysis, or Management Consulting. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones. Strong proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required.


PMP certification is a strong plus.


Education

title: Project Manager and Analyst
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a high-impact Project Manager & Analyst who thrives at the intersection of data-driven insights and operational excellence.

You will be the driving engine of our project executions, responsible for translating complex data into actionable project plans and managing relevant stakeholder, client, and executive communications.


Key Responsibilities


1. Project Management

  • End-to-End Oversight: Lead cross-functional projects from initial scoping through to final delivery, ensuring timelines and quality benchmarks are met.
  • Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in our current workflows and design scalable solutions to improve efficiency across the organization. Author standard operating procedures (SOPs) and forms.
  • Resource Allocation: Monitor project health and adjust resources dynamically to meet shifting business priorities.


2. Data Analysis & Insights

  • Analytical Rigor: Synthesize large datasets to identify trends, track KPIs, and provide insights that influence company growth.
  • Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility into project performance and departmental goals.
  • Risk Mitigation: Use quality management systems and predictive analysis to identify potential project risks before they impact the bottom line.


3. Executive Communication

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary bridge between clients, technical, operations teams and the executive suite.
  • Presentations: Craft compelling narratives and slide decks for leadership meetings, distilling complex project statuses into clear, high-level summaries.
  • Alignment: Ensure all project goals are tightly aligned with Medcase’s overarching commercial and clinical objectives.


Who You Are

  • A Master of Organization: You use project management principles, like Agile methodologies and tools to optimize processes.
  • Analytically Minded: You are comfortable with SQL, Google Sheets, AppScript, Looker Studio and possess a natural curiosity to dig into the \"why\" behind the numbers.
  • An Exceptional Communicator: You know how to be concise, persuasive, and professional. Present your ideas and insights using storytelling and with ease.
  • Proactive: You don't wait for a roadmap; you help build it.


Qualifications


Experience

3–5 years in Project Management, Business Analysis, or Management Consulting. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones. Strong proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required.


PMP certification is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Healthcare Admin, Health Tech or a related field.


Tech Stack

Proficiency in PM software (Slack, Notion), CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot/Odoo), and BI tools (Tableau/PowerBI/Looker Studio). Agile tools / methodologies.


Industry

title: Senior Account Manager - Marketing de Influência
description:
SOBRE A ORI

A Ori é uma startup end-to-end focada em transformar a visão do mercado sobre a Creators Economy, transformando criadores em um canal de Performance alinhando criatividade, tecnologia e dados.

Assim como nossos produtos trouxeram escala para nossos clientes, nós também crescemos com os projetos e com isso, chegou a hora de expandirmos!

Com grande parte dos clientes nas verticais de Beauty, Fashion, Serviços e Finance, estamos em busca de um(a) novo(a) Account Manager Sr para reforçar nosso time estratégico!


QUEM É VOCÊ

  • Experiência com Client Facing: +3 anos de experiência com atendimento estratégico de clientes B2B | Ter trabalhado com Influence Marketing é um diferencial.
  • Data Driven: todas as decisões da empresa e clientes são baseados em dados, PERFIL ANALÍTICO E PRAGMÁTICO É IMPRESCINDÍVEL.
  • Heavy User de Redes Sociais: referências são o nosso norte!
  • Conhecimento em cultura digital e o que há de novo no mercado;
  • Muita criatividade, autonomia e vontade de crescer junto.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Já ter trabalhado com Moda, Serviços ou Beauty;
  • Experiência prévia com Influence Marketing;
  • Já ter trabalhado em canal/equipe de Growth;
  • Uso de AI no dia a dia.


O QUE VOCÊ FARÁ

  • Gestão de relacionamento com clientes e influenciadores, garantindo alinhamento entre objetivos de negócio e entregas de conteúdo;
  • Elaboração de análises e relatórios de performance de campanhas, com recomendações de otimização baseadas em dados;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias de crescimento da sua carteira, incluindo iniciativas de upsell e cross-sell dentro do ecossistema de produtos da Ori;
  • Participação ativa na construção de projetos e campanhas com marcas, contribuindo com visão estratégica, criatividade e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Salário Competitivo
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido - 2x na semana no escritório em São Paulo - SP
  • Assinatura WeWork All Access - Trabalhe de qualquer lugar do mundo
  • Vale Transporte (opcional)
  • 13º + 30 dias de férias

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Vaga: Business Development Representative (BDR) - 100% Outbound
Local: Presencial - WeWork Perdizes (São Paulo/SP)
Horário: 09h - 18h
Contratação: PJ
Facilidade: Fica próximo ao Metrô Barra Funda, com saída de van gratuita a cada 10 minutos do terminal até o prédio.
Quem somos e o que buscamos:
Somos uma consultoria de benefícios com uma cultura orientada a processos, metas, indicadores e alta performance.
Estamos em busca de um(a) BDR \"Hunter\" para atuar 100% com prospecção ativa (Outbound). Sua missão será gerar novas vendas através de Cold Calling, Cold E-mail e Networking.
Responsabilidades:
● Realizar prospecção ativa diária (Cold Call e E-mail) com foco exclusivo em gerar novas vendas.
● Construir, enriquecer e higienizar listas frias, segmentando por mercado, perfil de cliente ideal (ICP) e concorrência.
● Adaptar o discurso comercial (Pitch) para a dor específica de cada segmento e prospect.
● Gerenciar suas metas individuais de volume de atividades e geração de oportunidades diárias.
Requisitos Obrigatórios:
● Vivência comprovada em Outbound Sales / Prospecção Ativa B2B.
● Experiência real com Cold Calling (não ter medo de ligar) e abordagem ativa.
● Conhecimento e uso diário de CRM (Kommo ou similares).
● Altamente comercial, disciplinado(a), consistente e movido(a) a metas.
● Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento.
Diferenciais:
● Experiência prévia em vendas de serviços ou SaaS.
● Domínio de plataformas de prospecção e enriquecimento de dados (Driva ou Econodata, etc.).
● Conhecimento prático em metodologias de vendas (SPIN Selling, Receita Previsível, BANT).

title: Gerente de Contas - Account Manager
description:
Sobre a Advanced


A Advanced Informática Ltda. é parceira oficial da Microsoft, especializada em soluções de nuvem, produtividade, inteligência artificial e telecomunicações. Estamos em expansão e buscamos um Gerente de Contas para integrar nossa equipe comercial e contribuir para o crescimento da empresa.


- Responsabilidades

Apoiar a equipe comercial nas etapas finais de negociação com clientes em potencial, fornecendo suporte e informações cruciais para auxiliar no fechamento de contratos.

Desenvolver e revisar propostas comerciais, garantindo alinhamento com as expectativas dos clientes e destacando os benefícios dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Estabelecer um relacionamento inicial com clientes potenciais, ajudando-os a compreender o valor agregado das nossas soluções e mantendo uma comunicação clara e acolhedora.

Identificar novas oportunidades de vendas em parceria com a equipe sênior, propondo soluções personalizadas que atendam às necessidades específicas dos clientes.

Facilitar a transição do cliente para o pós-venda, assegurando uma experiência positiva e uma comunicação fluída desde o fechamento até o onboarding inicial.

Organizar e atualizar o pipeline de negociações sob supervisão, garantindo que os dados estejam sempre precisos e contribuindo para a visibilidade da equipe comercial.

Acompanhar os KPIs de conversão e colaborar na melhoria contínua do processo de vendas, com foco em aprendizado constante e fechamento de negócios.



-Requisitos


Experiência prévia como Gerente de Contas ou em funções comerciais de negociação e desenvolvimento de propostas (desejável).

Excelente capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.

Perfil colaborativo e empático, com habilidades para construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes.

Organização e disciplina no acompanhamento de pipelines e processos comerciais.

Desejável conhecimento em CRM (preferencialmente Dynamics 365 Sales).

Foco em resultados e aprendizado contínuo no fechamento de vendas.

Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em  Goiânia - GO.

description:

A CareOn nasceu com o objetivo de fazer a diferença no setor da saúde, usar a tecnologia, jovialidade e criatividade para desenvolver soluções para otimizar processos de contratação de mão de obra, melhorar as condições de trabalho dos profissionais e dar a eles mais oportunidades de carreira e destaque no mercado.

title: Controlador de Acesso
description:
Estamos em busca de profissionais atentos, cordiais e proativos para integrar nossa equipe de monitoramento e recepção em empreendimentos residenciais de médio e alto padrão na Zona Leste de São Paulo . Se você preza pela organização, segurança e pelo atendimento de excelência, essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Gestão de Fluxo: Controle rigoroso de entrada e saída de moradores, colaboradores, visitantes e prestadores de serviços, seguindo as normas de segurança sem exceções.
  • Identificação e Cadastro: Registro de dados em sistemas informatizados ou planilhas, com verificação de documentos de forma respeitosa e ágil.
  • Recebimento de Mercadorias: Protocolar encomendas e correspondências, notificando os destinatários conforme os procedimentos internos.
  • Atendimento e Orientação: Prestar informações com postura empática, neutra e profissional, garantindo um ambiente seguro e acolhedor.


Qualificações Necessárias


  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência: Vivência anterior como controlador(a) de acesso, porteiro(a) ou em atendimento ao público (será um diferencial).
  • Habilidades: Excelente comunicação verbal, capacidade de mediação de conflitos e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Localização: Ter fácil acesso às regiões da Zona Leste (São Paulo) .
  • Certificações (Desejável): Curso de formação em Controladoria de Acesso ou Segurança Patrimonial atualizado.


Remuneração e Benefícios


  • Salário: R$ 2.162,60
  • Vale Refeição (VR): R$ 21,80 por dia.

title: Gerente de Contas - Account Manager
description:
Sobre a Advanced


A Advanced Informática Ltda. é parceira oficial da Microsoft, especializada em soluções de nuvem, produtividade, inteligência artificial e telecomunicações. Estamos em expansão e buscamos um Gerente de Contas para integrar nossa equipe comercial e contribuir para o crescimento da empresa.


- Responsabilidades

Apoiar a equipe comercial nas etapas finais de negociação com clientes em potencial, fornecendo suporte e informações cruciais para auxiliar no fechamento de contratos.

Desenvolver e revisar propostas comerciais, garantindo alinhamento com as expectativas dos clientes e destacando os benefícios dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Estabelecer um relacionamento inicial com clientes potenciais, ajudando-os a compreender o valor agregado das nossas soluções e mantendo uma comunicação clara e acolhedora.

Facilitar a transição do cliente para o pós-venda, assegurando uma experiência positiva e uma comunicação fluída desde o fechamento até o onboarding inicial.

Organizar e atualizar o pipeline de negociações sob supervisão, garantindo que os dados estejam sempre precisos e contribuindo para a visibilidade da equipe comercial.

Acompanhar os KPIs de conversão e colaborar na melhoria contínua do processo de vendas, com foco em aprendizado constante e fechamento de negócios.



-Requisitos


Experiência prévia como Gerente de Contas ou em funções comerciais de negociação e desenvolvimento de propostas (desejável).

Excelente capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.

Perfil colaborativo e empático, com habilidades para construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes.

Organização e disciplina no acompanhamento de pipelines e processos comerciais.

Desejável conhecimento em CRM (preferencialmente Dynamics 365 Sales).

Foco em resultados e aprendizado contínuo no fechamento de vendas.

Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em  Goiânia - GO.

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Project Manager and Analyst
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a high-impact Project Manager & Analyst who thrives at the intersection of data-driven insights and operational excellence.

You will be the driving engine of our project executions, responsible for translating complex data into actionable project plans and managing relevant stakeholder, client, and executive communications.


Key Responsibilities


1. Project Management

  • End-to-End Oversight: Lead cross-functional projects from initial scoping through to final delivery, ensuring timelines and quality benchmarks are met.
  • Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in our current workflows and design scalable solutions to improve efficiency across the organization. Author standard operating procedures (SOPs) and forms.
  • Resource Allocation: Monitor project health and adjust resources dynamically to meet shifting business priorities.


2. Data Analysis & Insights

  • Analytical Rigor: Synthesize large datasets to identify trends, track KPIs, and provide insights that influence company growth.
  • Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility into project performance and departmental goals.
  • Risk Mitigation: Use quality management systems and predictive analysis to identify potential project risks before they impact the bottom line.


3. Executive Communication

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary bridge between clients, technical, operations teams and the executive suite.
  • Presentations: Craft compelling narratives and slide decks for leadership meetings, distilling complex project statuses into clear, high-level summaries.
  • Alignment: Ensure all project goals are tightly aligned with Medcase’s overarching commercial and clinical objectives.


Who You Are

  • A Master of Organization: You use project management principles, like Agile methodologies and tools to optimize processes.
  • Analytically Minded: You are comfortable with SQL, Google Sheets, AppScript, Looker Studio and possess a natural curiosity to dig into the \"why\" behind the numbers.
  • An Exceptional Communicator: You know how to be concise, persuasive, and professional. Present your ideas and insights using storytelling and with ease.
  • Proactive: You don't wait for a roadmap; you help build it.


Qualifications


Experience

3–5 years in Project Management, Business Analysis, or Management Consulting. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones. Strong proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required.


PMP certification is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Healthcare Admin, Health Tech or a related field.


Tech Stack

Proficiency in PM software (Slack, Notion), CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot/Odoo), and BI tools (Tableau/PowerBI/Looker Studio). Agile tools / methodologies.


Industry

Experience in HealthTech or SaaS is highly preferred. Familiarity with healthcare terminology or AI/data projects is a plus.


Why Medcase?

Medcase is a supplier of global clinician expertise to the world’s leading healthcare AI organizations. We operate to streamline the human in the loop service for data curation and AI training. You will be working alongside the giants of the medical AI space. Learn from and contribute to an innovative fast developing field. Our remote first roles offer a lot of flexibility, and opportunities for growth within the startup framework.


Ready to apply? We value clarity, precision, and a bias for action. If this sounds like you, let's talk.


Learn more about

Se você preza pela organização, segurança e pelo atendimento de excelência, essa oportunidade é para você.

  • Gestão de Fluxo: Controle rigoroso de entrada e saída de moradores, colaboradores, visitantes e prestadores de serviços, seguindo as normas de segurança sem exceções.

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência: Vivência anterior como controlador(a) de acesso, porteiro(a) ou em atendimento ao público (será um diferencial).
  • Habilidades: Excelente comunicação verbal, capacidade de mediação de conflitos e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Localização: Ter fácil acesso às regiões da Zona Leste (São Paulo) .
  • Certificações (Desejável): Curso de formação em Controladoria de Acesso ou Segurança Patrimonial atualizado.


Remuneração e Benefícios


  • Salário: R$ 2.162,60
  • Vale Refeição (VR): R$ 21,80 por dia.
  • Cesta Básica: R$ 151,91 + Cesta Básica II de R$ 315,00.
  • Saúde: Plano Odontológico Bradesco (sem custo para o colaborador).
  • PLR: Participação nos Lucros e Resultados paga 2x ao ano.
  • Bem-estar e Lazer: Parcerias com SESC e descontos exclusivos em parques (Hopi Hari, Wet 'n Wild, Neogeo, Jump’n Joy, Parque da Mônica e outros).


⏰ Jornada e Condições
  • Escala: 12x36.
  • Horários: 06h00 às 18h00 ou 18h00 às 06h00.
  • Contratação: Oportunidade Efetiva (CLT) para início imediato.
  • ⚠️ Importante: Não trabalhamos com conciliação de horários.

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!

- Graduação em Administração

- Pós-Graduação em Gestão de Negócios

- MBA em Gestão Empresarial

- Cursos de Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas

- Conhecimento em Lean Six Sigma

- Experiência comprovada em gestão de pessoas, liderança, gestão financeira, planejamento estratégico, gestão de projetos, gestão de processos, negociação, gestão de contratos, gestão de qualidade e gestão de riscos

- Habilidade em comunicação, trabalho em equipe, resiliência, flexibilidade e proatividade

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.

Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!

#VemPraLiora #EnergiaSimples #Transformação #VendasComPropósito

title: Analista de Tesouraria Jr (Crédito e Cobrança)

title: Gerente de Negócios
description:
Edenred é uma plataforma digital líder em serviços e pagamentos e a companhia diária para as pessoas no trabalho, conectando mais de 850.000 clientes corporativos, 50 milhões de usuários, 2 milhões de comerciantes parceiros em 44 países por meio de 4 linhas de negócios:

• MOVE : Gestão de Combustível e Frota, Frete, Manutenção, Pedágio

• EAT & CARE : Refeições e Alimentos, Cultura, Incentivos & Recompensas e Saúde

• PAY : Gestão de despesas, pagamento de salários e comissões para trabalhadores independentes e prestadores de serviços

• ACQUIRING : soluções para comerciantes

Estamos no centro de uma rede virtuosa que agrega valor aos seus clientes:

• Empresas e setor público , preocupados em ser empregadores atraentes, motivando suas equipes e otimizando seu desempenho

• Funcionários e cidadãos , que apreciam a simplicidade e conveniência de nossas soluções de pagamento para tornar suas vidas mais fáceis

• Comerciantes (restaurantes, lojas, postos de gasolina, etc.) que buscam aumentar sua receita, fidelizar seus clientes e tornar suas transações mais seguras

Nossos 12.000 funcionários estão comprometidos em tornar o mundo do trabalho um lugar melhor para todos , mais seguro, eficiente e fácil de usar

Com 1.500 funcionários, nossa linha de negócios MOVE no Brasil é a maior do grupo . Estamos agora regionalizando nossas operações MOVE em nível LATAM, proporcionando assim exposição internacional e oportunidades para nossos funcionário s. Daqui para frente, nossa linha de negócios continuará a entregar um crescimento sustentável e lucrativo de dois dígitos

Procuramos talentos que partilhem a nossa ambição, que queiram representar, desafiem-nos e a si próprios a seguir em frente todos os dias. Procuramos profissionais que vibram conosco e que partilham os nossos valores: paixão pelos clientes, respeito, imaginação, simplicidade e espírito empreendedor

Na Edenred, acreditamos que grandes conexões são uma força imparável. Nós os canalizamos para fortalecer negócios e fomentar soluções inclusivas. Criamos ecossistemas locais que criam mais riqueza. E mais saúde. Não só para as pessoas, mas também para o nosso meio ambiente. Melhores laços podem melhorar a vida. Damos a eles um propósito: promover o progresso .

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão são mais do que adesivos em nossas paredes, são pilares essenciais na gestão de pessoas e um compromisso com nossa sociedade. Portanto, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de deficiência, raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra diversidade.

Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!

Para todos que procuram esse tipo de VIBE em sua vida profissional, somos o melhor lugar para você!

Missão do cargo

Responsável por prospectar novos clientes (empresas), criar e alimentar pipeline de oportunidades e conduzir o processo de venda desde a abordagem inicial até o fechamento, com foco em bater metas comerciais.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospecção ativa de clientes (cadastros frios, mapeamento de mercado, cold calls, LinkedIn, networking).
  • Identificação de leads qualificados seguindo critérios de perfil ideal (segmento, porte, potencial).
  • Realização de reuniões presenciais e virtuais com decisores para apresentar soluções da Ticket Log.
  • Elaboração e negociação de propostas comerciais conforme diretrizes de pricing.
  • Gestão do funil de vendas (pipeline) e uso de CRM para registro de todas as interações, status de oportunidades, follow-ups etc.
  • Acompanhamento de todo o ciclo de venda: desde prospecção até a assinatura de contrato, entrega de documentação e ativação.
  • Atuação colaborativa com equipes internas (marketing, operações, implementação) para garantir o cumprimento de expectativas do cliente.
  • Monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e participação no planejamento de metas comerciais.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa (Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Relações Internacionais, Negócios ou áreas afins).
  • Experiência prévia comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente com perfil “hunter” (prospecção ativa).
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas consultivas (ex: SPIN, Challenger, venda por valor).
  • Habilidade de negociação e comunicação com stakeholders de diferentes níveis.
  • Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, Pipedrive ou similares).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas agressivas e foco em resultados.
  • Disponibilidade para deslocamentos, reuniões em campo e viagens constantes.
  • Desejável conhecimento no segmento de frotas, mobilidade ou cartões corporativos.
  • Inglês /intermediário será diferencial

O que esperamos?

Buscamos um profissional com perfil proativo, resiliente, orientado a resultados e com habilidade para trabalhar autonomamente. Que goste de desafios, tenha boa capacidade analítica e saiba lidar com pressão e metas agressivas.

title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Business developer & parcerias estratégicas
description:
Venha fazer parte da VelanaEstamos em busca de um(a) Business Developer & Parcerias Estratégicas com perfil estratégico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.
Essa posição envolve desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas e prospecção ativa de leads (outbound), contribuindo diretamente para a expansão da Velana no ecossistema de pagamentos digitais. Buscamos alguém que já tenha vivência com gateways de pagamento, seja proativo e consiga identificar oportunidades de alto valor tanto em parcerias quanto em contas potenciais.Sobre a Velana
A Velana é um gateway de pagamentos digital em crescimento acelerado, conectando e-commerces, plataformas e infoprodutores a soluções de pagamento seguras, eficientes e escaláveis.
Nossa expansão acontece através de tecnologia, estratégia comercial e desenvolvimento de parcerias relevantes dentro do ecossistema de pagamentos digitais.Principais Responsabilidades
Identificar e desenvolvernovas oportunidades de negócio e parcerias estratégicas;
Realizarprospecção ativa (outbound) de leads qualificados;
Prospectare-commerces, plataformas digitais, infoprodutores e parceiros estratégicospara integração com o gateway Velana;
Desenvolver e estruturarparcerias comerciais e canais de aquisição;
Atuar de forma consultiva apresentandosoluções de gateway de pagamento e processamento financeiro;
Analisar mercado, concorrência e tendências dentro do setor depagamentos digitais e fintechs;
Gerar oportunidades qualificadas para o time comercial;
Registrar e acompanhar oportunidades no CRM;
Trabalhar em conjunto comVendas, Produto e Marketingpara fortalecer a estratégia de expansão.✔️Requisitos Essenciais
Experiência emBusiness Development, Parcerias e Prospecção Comercial (outbound);
Experiência comgateways de pagamento, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
Comunicação clara e habilidade de relacionamento com decisores (CEOs, Founders, Heads);
Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a oportunidades;
Organização, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma.⭐Diferenciais
Experiência prévia atuando em gateways de pagamento, subadquirentes ou adquirentes;
Networking dentro do ecossistema de plataformas, produtores digitais e e-commerces;
Conhecimento em integrações de pagamento, APIs ou soluções financeiras digitais.O que oferecemos
Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e espaço para crescimento;
Contato direto com a liderança e participação ativa na expansão da empresa;
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional dentro de um mercado em forte crescimento;
Cultura voltada para resultado, colaboração e construção de longo prazo.✨

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date:Ongoing
Screener Criteria:Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations: Requirement:Fluent English
Type of contract:Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate:$60.00
Minimum Hours:No minimum
Maximum Hours:Ad hoc / Subject to project availabilityAbout Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.The Opportunity
We are invitingCertified Accountantsto join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis forB2 B and AI Researchprojects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note:This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.What you’ll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis:Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation:Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis:Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.What you’ll bring
Active certification:You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g.,CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA,or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor:The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective:We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity:All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At$60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.Links to more information on Prolific
Website
YoutubePrivacy Statement
By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Market intelligence manager - americas
description:
Summary of Job Duties
Ensure their regional team fulfils the roles and responsibilities of:
Customer development
Lead opportunity assessment: proactively engage in customer development, leverage marketing intelligence capability to assess customer opportunity, generate customer leads from current or potential opportunities driving from new developed product and formulation.
Customer development action plan: proactively engage in action plan formulation, and engage in customer communication and execution
Customer solution proposal: coordinate external resources to design customized market service plan based on customer’s need
Customer relationship management
Proactively engage in relationship mgmt. with KA’s marketing related departments, gathering market insights to support R&D and BD
Marketing service:
Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-salesMain ResponsibilitiesAlthough the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:Market Research
To visit customer site with sales and also collect market information in their region such as:
Customer Survey Analysis
Customer service needs/opportunities
Customer’s org chart
Customer’s end consumer insights and trends
Prospects and opportunity analysis
Category Analysis
Sales Channels
Competitive landscapeMarketing Support Service
Help promote, drive and expand our added value service to our customers to provide them with our 360 marketing solution
Market Research/Business Intelligence
Receipe support
`z Sales distributionAccount Based Marketing
Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:
Identify high-value target accounts –Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.
Conduct research on those accounts- Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey.
Develop customized marketing campaigns- Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account.
Run customized marketing campaigns- Launch your campaigns to the target account.
Measure customized marketing campaigns- Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.Online Marketing
Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region.
Webinars
SEO –Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage
Social media– Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based
Email marketing– Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.Offline Marketing
Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover
Exhibitions
Roadshows
Print (Quarterly updates)
Power Point presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)Public Relations
Build up media relations and ‘Distribution Media List’ for future press release distribution in their assigned region.
Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
Around 10 years of experience
Knowledgable in hands on B2 B2 C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.Skills NeededMarket Research and Analysis:The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.
Strategic Planning:Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.
Team Leadership and Management:Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.
Brand Management:They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.
Campaign Management:This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.
Budget Management:Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.
Data Analysis and Interpretation:Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.
Communication Skills:Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.
Adaptability and Flexibility:The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.
Problem-Solving Skills:Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.
Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity:Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.
Time Management:Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.
Tech-Savviness:Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.
Negotiation Skills:The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: People business partner
description:
This role is part of thePeople Successarea and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.
What You'll Do:
Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.What we expect from you:Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposurewithin tech companies.
Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
Previous experience with Workday is a plus.Soft Skills
Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
Strategic mindset with strong execution.
Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.What we offer:
Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

Nice to Have
Experience supporting international customers

Experience working with cross-functional teams (engineering or product)
Advantages
Competitive compensation
Fully remote work environment
International and collaborative team
Professional development opportunities

Fully remote position

Fast-paced and international environment with high service standards

R$6,000 a R$10,000 Reais per month.

Receipe support

Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
Around 10 years of experience
Knowledgable in hands on B2 B2 C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.Skills NeededMarket Research and Analysis:The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.
Strategic Planning:Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.
Team Leadership and Management:Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.
Brand Management:They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.
Campaign Management:This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.
Budget Management:Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.
Data Analysis and Interpretation:Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.
Communication Skills:Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.
Adaptability and Flexibility:The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.
Problem-Solving Skills:Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.
Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity:Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.
Time Management:Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.
Tech-Savviness:Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.
Negotiation Skills:The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

Mainframe DB2 LUW

title: Senior technical business analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) OverviewElastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.Role Responsibilities
Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
Manage documentation in tools such as Dev Ops, Jira or similar.Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience
5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
Proven experience in Data projects.
Technical background in:
Data architecture concepts
APIs & system integrations
Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
Strong stakeholder management skills.
Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).Our Values
We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.#1 Be the best you can be
We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.#2 We do what we say.
When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.#3 Together we win.
Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.Equal Opportunities at Acora
Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.
