title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Marketing specialist
description:

title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

Orange Storm is a leading venture-backed Ad Tech and AI Saa S company with dual headquarters in California, USA, and Barcelona, Spain. title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy & Campaign Execution
Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.Content & Brand Communication
Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.Digital Marketing & Analytics
Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.Requirements
Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
Solid understanding ofdigital marketing analytics and performance tracking.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
Knowledge of SEO is a plus.How to Apply
Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment
The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:
Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.

Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.

Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.

Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.

Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: People business partner
description:

title: Desenvolvedor rpa sênior – automation anywhere
description:
A Practia está presente em 9 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.
Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da Ui Path, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (Ui Path Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da Ui Path.
Estamos em busca de umDesenvolvedor RPA Sêniorpara atuar em um projeto estratégico, integrando um time de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.
Essa pessoa atuará de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a revisão da documentação funcional, avaliação de complexidade, suporte ao design e arquitetura da solução, desenvolvimento das automações, sustentação, monitoramento, implantação em produção e apoio ao período de hypercare.
Além disso, será treinada em nosso framework proprietário e metodologia de Hyperautomação Smart BPA®, que cobre toda a jornada — do Discovery à implementação do COE.
Como parte da equipe de Intelligent Automation, você colaborará com times multidisciplinares para entregar automações robustas, seguras, escaláveis e de alta qualidade.O que buscamos
Profissional sênior, com forte experiência em desenvolvimento e sustentação de automações.
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e com visão de qualidade e governança.
Alguém que gosta de atuar em ambientes que valorizam competência, transparência e confiança.
Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente iniciativas, apoiar decisões de arquitetura e orientar membros do time.Responsabilidades
Revisar documentação funcional, apoiar estimativas e propor melhorias.
Desenvolver, implantar, monitorar e sustentar automações no Automation Anywhere A360.
Construir e manter componentes reutilizáveis, boas práticas e padrões internos.
Integrar automações com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços corporativos e soluções de Gen AI/ML e IDP.
Atuar em projetos de migração de versões, refactoring ou atualizações de arquitetura A360.
Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução garantindo performance, segurança e compliance.
Contribuir para o fortalecimento do framework e processos internos de automação.
Realizar troubleshooting, análise raiz de incidentes e melhorias de estabilidade.
Apoiar testes integrados, homologação e hypercare de novas entregas.Requisitos
Formação em Tecnologia, Engenharia, Sistemas ou Administração.
Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática com Automation Anywhere (preferencialmente).
Certificações Automation Anywhere Advanced e Master. (Obrigatório)Experiência sólida em:
Sustentação e monitoramento de automações (Fila, Control Room, logs, dashboards).
Integração via APIs, bancos de dados e aplicações corporativas.
Desenvolvimento e depuração de workflows complexos.
Implementação de tratativas robustas de erro e resiliência.
Documentação PDD e SDD.
Uso de frameworks e boas práticas.
Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente pequenos times ou células de sustentação.Conhecimentos Diferenciais
Experiência com AWS, Azure ou GCP.
Domínio de produtos adicionais Automation Anywhere:
IA Agents
IA Studio
Document Automation
Enterprise Knowledge
Conhecimento em Python, VBScript ou Java Script.
Experiência com Gen AI, Machine Learning e IDP integrado a processos automatizados.
Outras certificações na área de automação inteligente, RPA, IA ou arquitetura.

title: Senior business analyst – supply chain
description:

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS

title: Sap s/4 hana brim application expert (experto en aplicaciones sap s/4 hana brim)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.
PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE
Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4 HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES
Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.SELECTION CRITERIA
Essential:
Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
Experience in S/4 HANA environment and Fiori applications.
Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timelineDesirable:
SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4 HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS
Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
Health and Safety accountability statements.
Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.We are the ASSA ABLOY Group
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

title: Editorial graphic designer (interiors + spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?
I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine

Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence SupplyWho You Are
3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design)
You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.What We're Building
Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.What We're Offering
Competitive Salary
10 days PTO per year
Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
Fully remoteHow to Apply

title: Senior technical business analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) OverviewElastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.Role Responsibilities
Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
Manage documentation in tools such as Dev Ops, Jira or similar.Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience
5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
Proven experience in Data projects.
Technical background in:
Data architecture concepts
APIs & system integrations
Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
Strong stakeholder management skills.
Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).Our Values
We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.#1 Be the best you can be
We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.#2 We do what we say.
When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.#3 Together we win.
Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.Equal Opportunities at Acora
Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.

title: Pessoa gerente financeira
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de PR e Marketing Tech da América Latina. Nós transformamos dados em decisões estratégicas. Com o uso de inteligência artificial e monitoramento de mídia de ponta, ajudamos marcas globais a entenderem sua reputação e o mercado em tempo real.
Somos movidos por inovação, mas o que realmente nos sustenta são as pessoas. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a tecnologia e a estratégia caminham juntas, seu lugar é aqui.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gestão de Pessoas e Estrutura da Área:
Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional.
Faturamento (Billing):
Assegurar a acuracidade e escalabilidade do faturamento, garantindo aderência ao modelo de negócio (Saa S/recorrente), com foco em eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos.
Contas a Receber (AR) e Gestão de Inadimplência:
Definir estratégias e acompanhar indicadores de recebimento, atuando na redução de inadimplência, melhoria do ciclo de caixa e eficiência na conversão de receita em caixa.
Contas a Pagar (AP) e Tesouraria:
Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros.
Compras e Gestão de Custos:
Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores.
Controles Internos e Compliance:
Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos.
Análises Gerenciais e Interface com Diretoria:
Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica.
Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência:
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada em gestão de áreas financeiras;
Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
Conhecimento sólido em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets). Também é legal se você tiver:
Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em empresas Saa S ou modelos de receita recorrente;
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;
Experiência com estruturação de processos, automações e melhoria contínua;
Conhecimento em indicadores financeiros de Saa S (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, etc.);
Experiência em interação com investidores, auditorias ou governança corporativa.

title: Bizdev & parcerias

title: Arquiteto de soluções sap
description:
Oportunidade de Carreira: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP no Grupo LPJ
Sobre o Grupo LPJ:
Com 20 anos de história, o Grupo LPJ é uma holding de consultorias com soluções especializadas em estratégia de negócios, sistemas SAP, gestão de processos, tecnologia e compliance tributário. Formado por empresas com expertise complementar, o grupo é parceiro de grandes marcas e reconhecido por entregar resultados consistentes, com inovação, agilidade e foco em pessoas. Aqui, acreditamos que o nosso maior diferencial está no talento e na dedicação dos nossos times.
As empresas BASE e SOURCE são especialistas em soluções SAP. Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. Com forte atuação em tecnologia, gestão de processos e metodologias ágeis, são ambientes ideais para quem busca crescimento técnico e novos desafios em projetos estratégicos.
Sobre o perfil:
Como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, será responsável por compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em propostas técnicas e comerciais robustas, viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da organização. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.
Responsabilidades Principais:
Entendimento de demanda: Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
Desenho de soluções SAP: Modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras) com autonomia, considerando inovação, viabilidade técnica e custo-benefício;
Documentação estratégica: Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva. Requisitos:
Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e Lean IX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio. Diferenciais:
Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + Service Now); Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!

title: Software application engineer
description:
***Please send your CV in English
About Foretellix:
Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix's Foretify TM toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V& V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.
Role Description:
Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.

Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V& V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R& D. Understand the customer's V& V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings. Requirements:
At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
Have excellent human relationship skills
Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional. Advantages:
Experience in ADAS/AV V& V, testing, and simulation.
Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the 'e' language, and/or System Verilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: Senior full-stack mobile engineer (react native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native i OS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.
Fly Me Out is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.
We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.
What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, Type Script, Tan Stack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/Type Script backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.
Day to day, you'll be working on things like:
Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with Type Script
Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team You should have:
5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
Strong experience with Expo, Type Script, and modern state management (Tan Stack Query, Zustand, or similar)
Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome Nice to have:
Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:
Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026

title: It risk management lead
description:

title: English teacher
description:

You be your own boss and set your own schedule

title: Software application engineer
description:
***Please send your CV in English
About Foretellix:
Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix's Foretify TM toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V& V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.
Role Description:
Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.
What will you do:
Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V& V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R& D. Understand the customer's V& V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings. Requirements:
At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
Have excellent human relationship skills
Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional. Advantages:
Experience in ADAS/AV V& V, testing, and simulation.
Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the 'e' language, and/or System Verilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: Analista de relações com investidores e esg iii
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Helbor Empreendimentos S. A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3, a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.
A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia. Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e Power Point em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal. Informações adicionais
O que nós oferecemos:
Vale Alimentação
Vale Refeição
Assistência Médica
Assistência odontológica
Participação nos Resultados

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.
Links to more information on Prolific
Website
Youtube
Privacy Statement
By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

Admanage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & Tik Tok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50 M+ in ad spend. Our mission? Level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.
We make it easy to launch hundreds of ads in seconds, saving advertisers hours. And we're building AI-powered tools to programmatically create, launch, and manage ads, which is where you come in.
We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience, not just ideas. We commit to Git Hub multiple times a day and ship continuously.
Why This Role Rocks
This is a senior-level frontend role where you'll design and deliver features that directly impact how the top advertisers launch and manage hundreds of thousands of ads per month. You'll collaborate with the founding team (ex-Photoroom, ex-ZOE, ex-Nextdoor), shape our frontend architecture, and raise the bar for state management, testing, and performance.
You're not here to maintain, you're here to build a complex UI that's robust and well-tested.
Tech Stack
Frontend: Next.js 14, React 18, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion
State Management: Zustand
Testing: Vitest
Backend (light exposure): Node.js, Prisma, My SQL
Infra: R2 Cloudfalre, AWS S3, Vercel
Auth: Next Auth.js
APIs: Facebook Marketing API, Tik Tok Ads API
What You'll Do
Architect and scale the frontend for an app launching 900,000+ ads/month
Implement robust state management to handle complex, async, and data-heavy workflows
Build production-grade testing frameworks (unit, integration, E2 E) to support safe continuous deployment
Ship features end-to-end: idea → build → optimize for robust testing, speed and UX
You Might Be a Fit If You...
Have 1-4 years of experience building production React/Next.js apps
Are skilled at state management in large, complex apps
Believe testing is part of building, not an afterthought
Care about performance, UX, and clean design systems
Communicate clearly, move fast, and thrive in a startup culture
Bonus Points For
Experience with ad APIs (Meta, Tik Tok, IG)
Prisma + My SQL experience
CI/CD pipeline knowledge (Vercel, Git Hub Actions)
Join Us If You Want To...
Build alongside experienced engineers and founders
Work with a modern stack and ship fast
Solve hard UX and state management challenges in adtech
Own what you build and shape our engineering culture
Grow into a Lead role as the company scales
How to Apply
Send your Git Hub, Linked In, and 2-3 lines on the hardest frontend problem you've solved lately. Bonus: links to anything you've built that makes you proud.
Interview Process
We start with a take home task where you'll be asked to identify bugs in a sample github repo and indicate how you would fix it.

title: Especialista em customer success / account manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin, somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.
Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.
É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
Relacionar-se com grandes empresas e stakeholders seniores
Entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções práticas, construindo e conduzindo planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco. Relacionamento Consultivo
Conduzir reuniões presenciais e apresentações executivas
Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times internos, sendo a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução. Operação & Execução
Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades. Requisitos e qualificações
Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
Conhecimento de métricas Saa S (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (Hub Spot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;
Disponibilidade e habilidade para conduzir reuniões presenciais com C-level
Residir na cidade de São Paulo ou municípios vizinhos. Desejáveis
Experiência com produtos Saa S B2 B;
Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;
Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: Wb D, Success Playbooks). Diferenciais
Atuação prévia em empresas com foco em reputação, comunicação, PRTech ou martech;
Familiaridade com metodologias de consultoria (Mc Kinsey, Bain, BCG);
Experiência com processos de expansão e cross-sell;
Histórico de alta performance em ambientes com metas arrojadas;
Participação na construção de processos, playbooks ou CS Ops;
Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de transformação e crescimento acelerado. Cultura de Cliente
Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);
Contribuir para uma operação ágil, simples e baseada em dados (planos efetivos);
Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.

title: Pessoa gerente financeira
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de PR e Marketing Tech da América Latina. Nós transformamos dados em decisões estratégicas. Com o uso de inteligência artificial e monitoramento de mídia de ponta, ajudamos marcas globais a entenderem sua reputação e o mercado em tempo real.
Somos movidos por inovação, mas o que realmente nos sustenta são as pessoas. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a tecnologia e a estratégia caminham juntas, seu lugar é aqui.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gestão de Pessoas e Estrutura da Área:
Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional.
Faturamento (Billing):
Assegurar a acuracidade e escalabilidade do faturamento, garantindo aderência ao modelo de negócio (Saa S/recorrente), com foco em eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos.
Contas a Receber (AR) e Gestão de Inadimplência:
Definir estratégias e acompanhar indicadores de recebimento, atuando na redução de inadimplência, melhoria do ciclo de caixa e eficiência na conversão de receita em caixa.
Contas a Pagar (AP) e Tesouraria:
Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros.
Compras e Gestão de Custos:
Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores.
Controles Internos e Compliance:
Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos.
Análises Gerenciais e Interface com Diretoria:
Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica.
Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência:
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada em gestão de áreas financeiras;
Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
Conhecimento sólido em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets). Também é legal se você tiver:
Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em empresas Saa S ou modelos de receita recorrente;
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;
Experiência com estruturação de processos, automações e melhoria contínua;
Conhecimento em indicadores financeiros de Saa S (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, etc.);
Experiência em interação com investidores, auditorias ou governança corporativa.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.
O que você vai fazer
→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida
→ Comunicação clara e maturidade pra dar feedbacks difíceis
Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto
---
ATENÇÃO — Como se candidatar
Não aceitamos candidaturas por aqui.
As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.
Candidate-se agora:
Leva cerca de 15 minutos. Você sabe na hora se avança.

title: Sap technical lead
description:
About SEW
Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and Io T-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.

420+ global clients across the U. S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
Millions of users engaged monthly
150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times Searching for your dream job? We are a true global company that values building meaningful relationships and maintaining an enthusiastic work environment while fostering innovation and creativity. At SEW, we believe that everyone contributes to our success, and in return, we provide opportunities for them to learn new skills and build a rewarding professional career.
Summary
We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP's core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks

Design scalable, high-performance architectures that support enterprise and utility-specific requirements

Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape

Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns
Proven experience implementing clean core–compliant extensibility
Deep knowledge of SAP IS-U in utility enterprise environments
Experience with SAP Service Cloud V2 and SAP CX integrations
Solid understanding of SAP BTP, including extension, integration, and API management services
Strong background in system integration, performance tuning, and scalability
Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions
Utility industry experience
Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory

title: Content operations specialist
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.
Company Description
Sofia Health is a U. S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.
We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, Linked In, social media, and podcast channels.
Role Description
The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.
This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.
The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.
What You Will Do
Content & Provider Curation
Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities Cross-Channel Content Management
Plan and coordinate content across:
Email marketing
Blog
Linked In
Social media
Podcast promotions
Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces Podcast & Media Coordination
