title: Bizdev & parcerias
description:
Venha fazer parte da Velana
Estamos em busca de um(a) Biz Dev & Parcerias Estratégicas com forte experiência no ecossistema de meios de pagamento e gateways, perfil estratégico e grande capacidade de relacionamento. Essa posição é focada no desenvolvimento de novos negócios e construção de parcerias estratégicas dentro do mercado de pagamentos digitais, com atuação voltada à expansão da Velana através de integrações, plataformas, e-commerces e parceiros do ecossistema. Buscamos alguém que já tenha vivência com gateways de pagamento, compreenda a dinâmica do mercado e consiga identificar oportunidades de crescimento através de conexões estratégicas.
Sobre a Velana
A Velana é um gateway de pagamentos digital em crescimento acelerado, conectando e-commerces, plataformas e infoprodutores a soluções de pagamento seguras e eficientes. Nossa expansão passa por tecnologia, estratégia comercial e desenvolvimento de parcerias relevantes.
Principais Responsabilidades
Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio no mercado de meios de pagamento;
Prospectar e-commerces, plataformas digitais, infoprodutores e parceiros estratégicos para integração com o gateway Velana;
Desenvolver e estruturar parcerias estratégicas com plataformas, agências, comunidades e soluções do ecossistema digital;
Atuar de forma consultiva apresentando soluções de gateway de pagamento, adquirência e processamento;
Identificar oportunidades de integração com plataformas e sistemas que utilizem ou demandem soluções de pagamento;
Analisar mercado, concorrência e tendências dentro do setor de pagamentos digitais e fintechs;
Gerar oportunidades qualificadas para o time comercial;
Registrar e acompanhar oportunidades no CRM;
Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de Vendas, Produto e Marketing para fortalecer a estratégia de expansão. Requisitos Essenciais
Experiência comprovada com gateways de pagamento, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
Vivência no ecossistema de fintechs, e-commerce, plataformas digitais ou Saa S;
Experiência em Business Development, parcerias estratégicas ou desenvolvimento de negócios;
Forte capacidade de relacionamento e construção de networking estratégico;
Boa comunicação e habilidade de negociação com decisores (CEOs, Founders, Heads);
Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a oportunidades.
Networking dentro do ecossistema de plataformas, produtores digitais e e-commerces;
Conhecimento em integrações de pagamento, APIs ou soluções financeiras digitais. O que Oferecemos
• Autonomia para estruturar e testar estratégias de desenvolvimento de negócios;
• Atuação direta no coração da operação da Velana;
• Ambiente ágil, colaborativo e sem burocracia;
• Contratação PJ | 100% remoto;
• Remuneração compatível com o nível do profissional
(com abertura para ajuste conforme senioridade e potencial de impacto);
• Oportunidade real de crescimento em uma fintech em expansão.
Por que a Velana?
Na Velana, desenvolvimento de negócios não é só execução. Você terá espaço para pensar, testar e construir novas frentes que impactam diretamente o crescimento da empresa.
100% Remoto | PJ | Possibilidade de bônus por performance

title: Senior full-stack engineer (python + react) — ai startupsenior full-stack engineer - ai productivity platform (remote)
description:
Position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI Platform)
About Us
We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.
Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.
Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.
This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.
Responsibilities
Backend & Platform
Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
Develop and evolve RESTful and Web Socket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability Frontend & User Experience
Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and Type Script
Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices Cross-Cutting
Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar Requirements
5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (Fast API or similar)
Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and Type Script
Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Dynamo DB)
Experience with relational and non-relational databases
Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team Nice-to-Haves
Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. Open Search)
Experience with real-time interfaces (Web Sockets, streaming, SSE)
Background in enterprise Saa S platforms
Experience with Vercel for frontend hosting and deployment
Knowledge of authentication systems (e.g. Clerk, Auth0)
Knowledge of security best practices and compliance (SOC 2 is a plus)
Experience working with high-scale or high-availability systems What We Offer
Work on cutting-edge AI systems used by enterprise customers
High-impact role with ownership across the full stack
Flexible remote work (Worldwide)
Direct collaboration with experienced engineers and founders
Fast-paced environment with real production challenges
Strong influence on technical and product decisions Location Remote (Worldwide)
Hiring Model Contractor
How to Apply Please reply here with your CV or portfolio. If you enjoy building serious full-stack systems for real AI products — from the Python services that power intelligent workflows to the React interfaces that put them in users' hands — we'd love to hear from you.

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.

description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.
Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?
Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.
About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.
Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
Test Planning and Execution: Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality.
Defect Management: Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
Collaboration: Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality.
Automation: Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks.
Quality Standards: Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.

title: Arquiteto de soluções sap
description:
Oportunidade de Carreira: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP no Grupo LPJ
Sobre o Grupo LPJ:
Com 20 anos de história, o Grupo LPJ é uma holding de consultorias com soluções especializadas em estratégia de negócios, sistemas SAP, gestão de processos, tecnologia e compliance tributário. Formado por empresas com expertise complementar, o grupo é parceiro de grandes marcas e reconhecido por entregar resultados consistentes, com inovação, agilidade e foco em pessoas. Aqui, acreditamos que o nosso maior diferencial está no talento e na dedicação dos nossos times.
As empresas BASE e SOURCE são especialistas em soluções SAP. Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. Com forte atuação em tecnologia, gestão de processos e metodologias ágeis, são ambientes ideais para quem busca crescimento técnico e novos desafios em projetos estratégicos.
Sobre o perfil:
Como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, será responsável por compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em propostas técnicas e comerciais robustas, viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da organização. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.
Responsabilidades Principais:
Entendimento de demanda: Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
Desenho de soluções SAP: Modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras) com autonomia, considerando inovação, viabilidade técnica e custo-benefício;
Documentação estratégica: Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva. Requisitos:
Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e Lean IX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio. Diferenciais:
Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + Service Now); Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!
#Vem Ser LPJ
#Compartilhe

Na IBR Tecnologia, lideramos a transformação dos Centros de Desmonte Veicular (CDVs) no Brasil desde 2012. Somos pioneiros em soluções tecnológicas para o setor, desenvolvendo sistemas que empoderam empresas e pessoas.

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Website
Youtube
Privacy Statement
By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Senior full-stack mobile engineer (react native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native i OS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.
Fly Me Out is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.
We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.
What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, Type Script, Tan Stack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/Type Script backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.
Day to day, you'll be working on things like:
Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with Type Script
Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team You should have:
5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
Strong experience with Expo, Type Script, and modern state management (Tan Stack Query, Zustand, or similar)
Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome Nice to have:
Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
Apple Pay integration experience Why Fly Me Out:
Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction Compensation & Terms
This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.
Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)
Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)
Health benefits: Not offered at this stage
Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis
Probation: 2 weeks
Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil
How to Apply
Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Advogado especialista em imigração
description:
Advogado(a) especialista em Imigração Internacional
A Access International Services é uma consultoria internacional em expansão, especializada em mobilidade global, estruturação patrimonial e soluções jurídicas estratégicas para clientes que buscam viver, investir ou expandir suas operações fora do Brasil.
Local de trabalho: Híbrido – Vila Olímpia, São Paulo – SP
Tipo de contrato: (PJ)
Remuneração: (a combinar)
Sobre a posição:
Como Advogado de Imigração - Legal Writer, você será responsável por:
Preparar documentos jurídicos e petições de imigração com excelência técnica e atenção aos detalhes;
Analisar a estratégia do caso e a documentação;
Pesquisar para reunir os detalhes necessários para documentos e materiais complementares;
Elaborar documentos de suporte (como cartas e resumos jurídicos) em inglês;
Garantir a conformidade com as regulamentações locais e internacionais de imigração;
Prestar suporte técnico-jurídico à equipe e aos clientes, desenvolvendo estratégias eficazes para cada caso;
Pesquisar jurisprudências e atualizar-se sobre mudanças nas políticas de imigração;
Redigir relatórios e análises com linguagem clara e objetiva. Requisitos:
Formação em Direito com OAB ativa;
Experiência mínima de 3 anos em processos de imigração, com foco em Estados Unidos;
Excelência na comunicação escrita, com domínio técnico e sensibilidade para diferentes contextos culturais;
Fluência em inglês (escrita e leitura avançadas; outros idiomas são um diferencial);
Perfil organizado, detalhista e proativo;
Habilidade para lidar com prazos e situações de pressão. Principais responsabilidades do cargo:
Redação de Pareceres e Relatórios;
Estudos de legislação estrangeira na esfera administrativa e jurídica;
Atuação em direito internacional privado, comércio exterior, imigração, documento e contratos internacionais;
Trabalho com as leis de cidadania, imigração, especialmente nas áreas de cidadania europeia, green card, e vistos;
Atuação com estruturas de holding e a legislação aplicável a empresas internacionais;
Interface com clientes (troca de e-mail, mensagens e telefonema);
Interface com parceiros no exterior. Diferenciais:
Experiência com Green Card (EB-2 NIW, EB-1, etc.);
Vivência com clientes high ticket;
Experiência com direito internacional privado;
Atuação com estruturas internacionais (empresas, holdings, etc.);
Admissão em BAR (EUA) será considerado um diferencial altamente relevante. Contato da vaga:
Envie seu currículo para:
Assunto: Imigração Internacional

title: Customer success associate
description:
About Ad Manage.ai Type: Full-Time We're building the Cursor for ad management.
Ad Manage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & Tik Tok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50 M+ in ad spend, our mission is to level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.
Our platform launches 900,000+ ads per month, saving advertisers hours with bulk ad creation, creative mining, and AI-powered campaign tools. We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience — not just ideas.
The Mission Our users are ambitious brands and agencies who rely on us not just for software, but for expertise that helps them scale profitably. That's where you come in.
We're looking for a Junior Customer Success Manager with a media buying background who can bridge the gap between software and performance marketing. You'll ensure our customers get real outcomes with Ad Manage.ai — not just features. You'll be supported by a strong CS team and learn fast.
What You'll Do
Support onboarding: help guide new customers from setup to first wins alongside senior team members.
Be a go-to resource: use your media buying knowledge to answer questions on campaign structure, creative testing, and platform features.
Drive adoption: help customers unlock the full value of features like bulk ad launching, creative mining, and performance dashboards.
Build relationships: be a reliable, friendly point of contact for brands, agencies, and growth teams.
Close the feedback loop: surface customer pain points to our product and engineering teams. We ship continuously — your insights will hit production fast.
Help reduce churn: flag at-risk accounts early and work with the team to find solutions. What We're Looking For
At least 6 months of experience in a customer-facing role (CSM, account management, support, or similar in a Saa S company).
Strong communication skills — you're confident on Google Meet, email, and Slack.
Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, including Claude Code for automating repetitive tasks, drafting customer communications, or building lightweight internal tools.
Startup mentality: eager to learn, comfortable with ambiguity, and happy to wear multiple hats.
Curiosity, empathy, and a bias for action are non-negotiable. Bonus Points For
Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or Tik Tok Ads at a campaign level
Any exposure to Saa S tools or ad tech platforms
Experience using Claude Code or similar agentic AI tools to automate workflows
Prior internship or junior role at a startup or agency
Some hands-on experience with paid social (Meta, Tik Tok) — whether through internships, agency work, freelance, or running your own campaigns. Why Join Us
Join an amazing Customer Success team and grow fast.
Direct impact: your feedback shapes our product roadmap from day one.
Work alongside founders who've scaled brands like ZOE, Photoroom, and Nextdoor. How to Apply Send your Linked In and 2–3 lines on: What's a performance marketing challenge you've helped solve — or one you're fascinated by? Bonus: any results or campaigns you're proud of, however small.

title: Frontend engineer – next.js / react
description:
Frontend Engineer – Next.js / React
Type: Full-Time
About Admanage.ai
We're building the Cursor for ad management.
Admanage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & Tik Tok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50 M+ in ad spend. Our mission? Level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.
We make it easy to launch hundreds of ads in seconds, saving advertisers hours. And we're building AI-powered tools to programmatically create, launch, and manage ads, which is where you come in.
We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience, not just ideas. We commit to Git Hub multiple times a day and ship continuously.
Why This Role Rocks
This is a senior-level frontend role where you'll design and deliver features that directly impact how the top advertisers launch and manage hundreds of thousands of ads per month. You'll collaborate with the founding team (ex-Photoroom, ex-ZOE, ex-Nextdoor), shape our frontend architecture, and raise the bar for state management, testing, and performance.
You're not here to maintain, you're here to build a complex UI that's robust and well-tested.
Tech Stack
Frontend: Next.js 14, React 18, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion
State Management: Zustand
Testing: Vitest
Backend (light exposure): Node.js, Prisma, My SQL
Infra: R2 Cloudfalre, AWS S3, Vercel
Auth: Next Auth.js
APIs: Facebook Marketing API, Tik Tok Ads API
What You'll Do
Architect and scale the frontend for an app launching 900,000+ ads/month
Implement robust state management to handle complex, async, and data-heavy workflows
Build production-grade testing frameworks (unit, integration, E2 E) to support safe continuous deployment
Ship features end-to-end: idea → build → optimize for robust testing, speed and UX
You Might Be a Fit If You...
Have 1-4 years of experience building production React/Next.js apps
Are skilled at state management in large, complex apps
Believe testing is part of building, not an afterthought
Care about performance, UX, and clean design systems
Communicate clearly, move fast, and thrive in a startup culture

title: It risk management lead
description:
IT Risk Management Lead
Comcentia is seeking an experienced IT Risk Management Lead to drive the design, build‐out, and continuous improvement of our client's enterprise IT Risk Management Program. This role leads the development of risk intake processes, assessment methodologies, and quantitative models aligned with NIST‐based frameworks and the organization's ISMS.
You'll partner with Cybersecurity, IT, business stakeholders, and risk owners to identify, assess, document, and monitor technology risks across the enterprise. The Lead serves as the primary SME for IT risk, producing executive‐ready reporting, maturing risk metrics and dashboards, and ensuring treatment plans are well‐defined, tracked, and executed.
Key Responsibilities:
• Lead structured IT risk assessments and apply quantitative scoring models
• Enhance risk intake processes, assessment tools, and framework alignment
• Maintain the enterprise risk register and map risks to SCF‐aligned controls
• Drive treatment planning, cross‐functional coordination, and lifecycle tracking
• Deliver risk reporting, dashboards, and decision‐ready materials for leadership
• Support governance cycles, audit readiness, and GRC tooling adoption
• Champion automation and AI‐enabled workflows to improve program efficiency
Qualifications:
• 7+ years in IT Risk Management, ISMS, or Cybersecurity
• Strong English proficiency (TOEFL Score: 90+) required
• Experience leading enterprise risk programs—not just contributing to them
• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI, GDPR
• Hands‐on experience with GRC platforms and risk assessment methodologies
• Excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences
• Preferred certifications: ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISSP, CISM, SCF Practitioner

title: Especialista em customer success / account manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin, somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.
Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.
É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
Relacionar-se com grandes empresas e stakeholders seniores
Entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções práticas, construindo e conduzindo planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco. Relacionamento Consultivo
Conduzir reuniões presenciais e apresentações executivas
Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times internos, sendo a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução. Operação & Execução
Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades. Requisitos e qualificações
Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
Conhecimento de métricas Saa S (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (Hub Spot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;
Disponibilidade e habilidade para conduzir reuniões presenciais com C-level
Residir na cidade de São Paulo ou municípios vizinhos. Desejáveis
Experiência com produtos Saa S B2 B;
Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;
Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: Wb D, Success Playbooks). Diferenciais
Atuação prévia em empresas com foco em reputação, comunicação, PRTech ou martech;
Familiaridade com metodologias de consultoria (Mc Kinsey, Bain, BCG);
Experiência com processos de expansão e cross-sell;
Histórico de alta performance em ambientes com metas arrojadas;
Participação na construção de processos, playbooks ou CS Ops;
Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de transformação e crescimento acelerado. Cultura de Cliente
Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);
Contribuir para uma operação ágil, simples e baseada em dados (planos efetivos);
Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.
O foco principal é no frontend — React, Next.js, performance, arquitetura de componentes, boas práticas. PHP existe na stack, mas a prioridade aqui é quem domina o mundo JS/TS moderno.
O que você vai fazer
→ Liderar tecnicamente o time (2 devs frontend plenos + 1 backend pleno + 1 sênior backend)
→ Conduzir code reviews de React e Next.js com critério e profundidade
→ Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentização e qualidade frontend
→ Estruturar o processo de desenvolvimento do zero
→ Identificar gargalos e remover bloqueios do time
→ Dar feedback claro e direto quando necessário
O que esperamos
→ Experiência sólida com React e Next.js (obrigatório)
→ Capacidade de liderar e fazer code review com autoridade técnica no frontend
→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código
→ Experiência com Type Script, boas práticas de performance e acessibilidade
→ Familiaridade com PHP é um diferencial, não um requisito
→ Experiência em estruturar processos em times sem metodologia definida
→ Comunicação clara e maturidade pra dar feedbacks difíceis
Remuneração: A combinar
100% Remoto
---
ATENÇÃO — Como se candidatar
Não aceitamos candidaturas por aqui.
As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.
Candidate-se agora:
Leva cerca de 15 minutos. Você sabe na hora se avança.

title: Program coordinator
description:
About Sofia HealthSofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we're making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.
Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, i Rest, health coaching, and more. About the Role
We're looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you'll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.
This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building. Responsibilities
Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery Requirements
1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
Ability to work independently in a remote environment Bonus Points
Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Content operations specialist
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.
Company Description
Sofia Health is a U. S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.
We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, Linked In, social media, and podcast channels.
Role Description
The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.
This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.
The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.
What You Will Do
Content & Provider Curation
Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities Cross-Channel Content Management
Plan and coordinate content across:
Email marketing
Blog
Linked In
Social media
Podcast promotions
Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels

title: Contract clinical research associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)
Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.
About Clinergy
Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.
Role Description
We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.
Activities
Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
Verify the accuracy of study results;
Identify and resolve site issues; Requirements
Bachelor's degree in life sciences;
2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
Advanced/Fluent in English;
Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices Skills
Self driven individual
Sense of urgency
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Good problem solving skills
Enthusiastic and energetic To apply for this opportunity please send your updated CV to
Note: Candidates who do not possess the mandatory requirements specified above will not be considered.
